title: Everyday Phrases — Buying Fresh Flowers
scene_zh: 花店買花 · 情境對話
title_quote: Good morning! I need flowers today.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】💐 實用「買花」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡800句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Buying Fresh Flowers
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「買花」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是街角那間老花店：告訴老闆娘三束花各要送給誰、問每種花代表的意思、挑顏色與枝數、說出預算請她配一束、選包裝紙與免費麻繩、寫卡片賀詞、約明天早上同一輛貨車跑三個點送到，最後問回家怎麼澆水、怎麼讓花多撐幾天。800 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。常用句型包含請人推薦、問價位與送貨、說明送禮對象、交代照顧花的步驟。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Buying Fresh Flowers' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). The scene is an old corner flower shop: telling the florist who each of the three bunches is for, asking what each flower means, choosing colors and how many stems, giving a budget and letting her design the bunch, picking wrapping paper and free jute twine, writing the card message, arranging one van for three morning stops, and finally learning how to change the water so the flowers last. 800 lines on repeat, A2 level, easy to repeat out loud even from zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning! I need flowers today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔrnɪŋ aɪ nid ˈflaʊɚz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 早安，我今天要買花。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome. Who are these flowers for?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm hu ɑr ðiz ˈflaʊɚz fɚ/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎，這些花是要送給誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A gift for my mother's birthday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡɪft fɚ maɪ ˈmʌðɚz ˈbɚθˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 是給我媽媽的生日禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her birthday wants a bright bunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɚ ˈbɚθˌdeɪ wɑnts ə braɪt bʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 生日該配一束亮色的花。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty years old, tomorrow evening.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti jɪrz oʊld təˈmɑroʊ ˈivnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 她明天晚上滿六十歲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That number needs a proper bunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈnʌmbɚ nidz ə ˈprɑpɚ bʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 這個數字值得一束像樣的花。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The party is small, just family.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpɑrti ɪz smɔl dʒʌst ˈfæməli/
dialogue.zh: 派對很小，只有家人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small tables like one short bunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ˈteɪbəlz laɪk wʌn ʃɔrt bʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 小桌子適合矮矮的一束。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you help me choose the bunch?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən ju hɛlp mi tʃuz ðə bʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 你能幫我挑一束嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First, tell me her favorite colors.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst tɛl mi hɚ ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈkʌlɚz/
dialogue.zh: 先告訴我她喜歡什麼顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pink and cream, nothing too bright.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪŋk ənd krim ˈnʌθɪŋ tu braɪt/
dialogue.zh: 粉紅和奶油色，不要太鮮豔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those two make a gentle mix.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoz tu meɪk ə ˈdʒɛntəl mɪks/
dialogue.zh: 這兩色搭配起來很柔和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her balcony already has green plants.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɚ ˈbælkəni ɔlˈrɛdi hæz ɡrin plænts/
dialogue.zh: 她的陽台已經有很多綠植。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then add stems, not a wide vase.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn æd stɛmz nɑt ə waɪd veɪs/
dialogue.zh: 那就加幾枝花，別用寬口花瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She grows tomatoes in every pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɡroʊz təˈmeɪtoʊz ɪn ˈɛvri pɑt/
dialogue.zh: 她每個盆子都種了番茄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Garden hands love simple flowers best.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɑrdən hændz lʌv ˈsɪmpəl ˈflaʊɚz bɛst/
dialogue.zh: 動手園藝的人最喜歡單純的花。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No strong smell, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ strɔŋ smɛl pliz/
dialogue.zh: 請不要氣味太重的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heavy lilies would tire her quickly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛvi ˈlɪliz wʊd ˈtaɪɚ hɚ ˈkwɪkli/
dialogue.zh: 太濃的百合會讓她很快就累。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly. She gets a headache fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ʃi ɡɛts ə ˈhɛdˌeɪk fæst/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，她一下子就頭痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we keep her bunch light and cool.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi kip hɚ bʌntʃ laɪt ənd kul/
dialogue.zh: 所以我們讓她那束清淡涼爽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing about this gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðɪs ɡɪft/
dialogue.zh: 這份禮物還有一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes? Does someone else give with you?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs dʌz ˈsʌmwʌn ɛls ɡɪv wɪð ju/
dialogue.zh: 嗯？還有別人跟你一起送嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sister and I give it together.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪstɚ ənd aɪ ɡɪv ɪt təˈɡɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我和姊姊一起送。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two names on one bunch is nicer.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu neɪmz ɑn wʌn bʌntʃ ɪz ˈnaɪsɚ/
dialogue.zh: 一束上寫兩個名字更貼心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We want one big bunch, not two.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɑnt wʌn bɪɡ bʌntʃ nɑt tu/
dialogue.zh: 我們要一大束，不要兩小束。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One bunch reads clearer, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bʌntʃ ridz ˈklɪrɚ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，一束的心意更清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mother loves a quiet little joke.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌðɚ lʌvz ə ˈkwaɪət ˈlɪtəl dʒok/
dialogue.zh: 媽媽喜歡暗暗的小笑話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A funny bloom can carry that, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈfʌni blum kən ˈkæri ðæt tu/
dialogue.zh: 一朵有趣的花也能帶出那個笑點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dad passed away last winter.
dialogue.phonetic: /dæd pæst əˈweɪ læst ˈwɪntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 爸爸去年冬天過世了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am sorry. A quiet bunch helps.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈsɑri ə ˈkwaɪət bʌntʃ hɛlps/
dialogue.zh: 我很難過。安靜的花束能安慰人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So no loud red for her, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ noʊ laʊd rɛd fɚ hɚ oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 所以別用太張的紅色，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deep red is a love message, mostly.
dialogue.phonetic: /dip rɛd ɪz ə lʌv ˈmɛsɪdʒ ˈmostli/
dialogue.zh: 深紅多半是情人之間的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is one more person, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz wʌn mɔr ˈpɜrsən ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不過還有一個人要送。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Who else is getting flowers today?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ɛls ɪz ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈflaʊɚz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天還有誰會收到花？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mrs. Chen next door watched her all month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪsɪz tʃɛn nɛkst dɔr wɑtʃt hɚ ɔl mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 隔壁的陳太太照顧她一整個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That kind of help deserves a bloom.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt kaɪnd əv hɛlp dɪˈzɜrvz ə blum/
dialogue.zh: 那種幫忙值得一朵花。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want a tiny bunch for her.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt ə ˈtaɪni bʌntʃ fɚ hɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我想給她一小束。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three stems are enough for thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri stɛmz ɑr ɪˈnʌf fɚ θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 三枝就夠說謝謝了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She is seventy and still walks far.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz ˈsɛvnti ənd stɪl wɔks fɑr/
dialogue.zh: 她七十歲了，還走得很遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bright yellow suits an active person.
dialogue.phonetic: /braɪt ˈjɛloʊ suts ən ˈæktɪv ˈpɜrsən/
dialogue.zh: 亮黃色很適合有活力的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also, no roses on that small one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ noʊ ˈroʊzɪz ɑn ðæt smɔl wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 還有，那小束不要玫瑰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood. Roses stay off her bunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɚˈstʊd ˈroʊzɪz steɪ ɔf hɚ bʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 了解，她那束不放玫瑰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you remember who gets what here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju rɪˈmɛmbɚ hu ɡɛts wʌt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 你記得這裡誰拿哪一束嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mother the big bunch, Mrs. Chen the small.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌðɚ ðə bɪɡ bʌntʃ ˈmɪsɪz tʃɛn ðə smɔl/
dialogue.zh: 大束給媽媽，小束給陳太太。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, my cousin wants her own flowers.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt maɪ ˈkʌzən wɑnts hɚ on ˈflaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 等等，我表妹也想要自己的花。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is her bunch a birthday gift, too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz hɚ bʌntʃ ə ˈbɚθˌdeɪ ɡɪft tu/
dialogue.zh: 她那束也是生日禮物嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hers is a get well bunch for the hospital.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜrz ɪz ə ɡɛt wɛl bʌntʃ fɚ ðə ˈhɑspɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 她那束是給醫院的康復花。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For that, calm white and green work best.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ ðæt kɑm waɪt ənd ɡrin wɜrk bɛst/
dialogue.zh: 那種場合，安靜的白和綠最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She is in the hospital now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz ɪn ðə ˈhɑspɪtəl naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 她現在住在醫院。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rooms there dislike heavy flower smells.
dialogue.phonetic: /rumz ðɛr dɪsˈlaɪk ˈhɛvi ˈflaʊɚ smɛlz/
dialogue.zh: 那裡的病房不喜歡濃花味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right. Nothing large, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ˈnʌθɪŋ lɑrdʒ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 對，那就不用太大的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small daisies are a safe choice there.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ˈdeɪziz ɑr ə seɪf tʃɔɪs ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 在那裡小雛菊最保險。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can all three bunches travel in one bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən ɔl θri ˈbʌntʃɪz ˈtrævəl ɪn wʌn bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 三束可以一起裝在同一個袋子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes. One carrier holds all three, no problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn ˈkæriɚ hoʊldz ɔl θri noʊ ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 可以，一個提袋裝得下三束。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are full after the bus ride.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hændz ɑr fʊl ˈæftɚ ðə bʌs raɪd/
dialogue.zh: 搭完公車我兩手都滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can send all three bunches by van.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kən sɛnd ɔl θri ˈbʌntʃɪz baɪ væn/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以三束一起用貨車送。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe later. Today I can carry them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ˈleɪtɚ təˈdeɪ aɪ kən ˈkæri ðəm/
dialogue.zh: 以後再說吧，今天我自己拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will loop the handle high.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl lup ðə ˈhændəl haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那我把提袋的把手打高一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I giving these in person, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ ˈɡɪvɪŋ ðiz ɪn ˈpɜrsən ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那我是要親手交給她囉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Handing a bunch over means a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhændɪŋ ə bʌntʃ ˈoʊvɚ minz ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 親手遞過去，意義大很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will say one line when I give it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl seɪ wʌn laɪn wɛn aɪ ɡɪv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 交花的時候我會說一句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep that line short and very warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðæt laɪn ʃɔrt ənd ˈvɛri wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 那句話要短，但要很暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty years is a long, good road.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti jɪrz ɪz ə lɔŋ ɡʊd roʊd/
dialogue.zh: 六十年是很長很好的路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say only that you are glad she is yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ˈoʊnli ðæt ju ɑr ɡlæd ʃi ɪz jɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 只要說你很高興她是你的媽媽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is hard to say out loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz hɑrd tə seɪ aʊt laʊd/
dialogue.zh: 那話很難說出口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flowers say it before your mouth does.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈflaʊɚz seɪ ɪt bɪˈfɔr jɔr maʊθ dʌz/
dialogue.zh: 花會先替你把話說出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mother keeps every dried leaf she gets.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌðɚ kips ˈɛvri draɪd lif ʃi ɡɛts/
dialogue.zh: 媽媽把她收到的乾葉都留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then press two petals inside her book.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn prɛs tu ˈpɛtəlz ɪnˈsaɪd hɚ bʊk/
dialogue.zh: 那就把兩片花瓣夾進她的書裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One tulip on her desk, maybe?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈtulɪp ɑn hɚ dɛsk ˈmeɪbi/
dialogue.zh: 在她桌上放一枝鬱金香好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A single stem does that job well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈsɪŋɡəl stɛm dʌz ðæt dʒɑb wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 一枝花在桌上就很有份量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her desk faces the morning window.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɚ dɛsk ˈfeɪsɪz ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 她的桌子正對著有晨光的窗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft light is kind to cut flowers.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft laɪt ɪz kaɪnd tə kʌt ˈflaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 柔和的光對剪下的花很溫柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will these last a week at her place?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðiz læst ə wik ət hɚ pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 這些在她家能撐一星期嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With clean water, about seven days, easily.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð klin ˈwɔtɚ əˈbaʊt ˈsɛvən deɪz ˈizəli/
dialogue.zh: 換清水的話，輕輕鬆鬆七天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. That is longer than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðæt ɪz ˈlɔŋɡɚ ðæn aɪ θɔt/
dialogue.zh: 好，比我以為的久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will note the cut date on the paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl noʊt ðə kʌt deɪt ɑn ðə ˈpeɪpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我會把剪下的日期寫在包裝上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please write it small, if that is okay.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz raɪt ɪt smɔl ɪf ðæt ɪz oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 可以的話請寫小一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tiny notes fit under the string knot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪni noʊts fɪt ˈʌndɚ ðə strɪŋ nɑt/
dialogue.zh: 小字條剛好塞在繩結下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the wording worries me a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈwɜrdɪŋ ˈwʌriz mi ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 接下來是措詞讓我有一點擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use her name plus one warm word.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz hɚ neɪm plʌs wʌn wɔrm wɜrd/
dialogue.zh: 寫她的名字，再加一個暖字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sister writes better handwriting than I do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪstɚ raɪts ˈbɛtɚ ˈhændˌraɪtɪŋ ðæn aɪ du/
dialogue.zh: 姊姊的字比我好看多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let her sign the lowest line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt hɚ saɪn ðə ˈloʊɪst laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那就請她簽在最下面那行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She lives far, so I sign for both.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi lɪvz fɑr soʊ aɪ saɪn fɚ boʊθ/
dialogue.zh: 她住得遠，所以兩個名字我簽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two names, one hand. That reads fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu neɪmz wʌn hænd ðæt ridz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 兩個名字一種筆跡，看起來沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you know any mother who skips flowers?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju noʊ ˈɛni ˈmʌðɚ hu skɪps ˈflaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 你認識不收花的媽媽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost none, my friend. Almost none.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst nʌn maɪ frɛnd ˈɔlmoʊst nʌn/
dialogue.zh: 幾乎沒有，朋友。幾乎沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Aunt Mei gave a potted plant last year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænt meɪ ɡeɪv ə ˈpɑtɪd plænt læst jɪr/
dialogue.zh: 美阿姨去年只送一盆盆栽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A plant is a gift that stays longest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə plænt ɪz ə ɡɪft ðæt steɪz ˈlɔŋɡɪst/
dialogue.zh: 盆栽是能留最久的禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bring her a plant this year, too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ brɪŋ hɚ ə plænt ðɪs jɪr tu/
dialogue.zh: 今年我也該送她一盆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three bunches are plenty for today.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈbʌntʃɪz ɑr ˈplɛnti fɚ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天有這三束就很夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us close the list now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt əs kloʊz ðə lɪst naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那我們把送的對象寫完。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big bunch for Mother, two small ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ bʌntʃ fɚ ˈmʌðɚ tu smɔl wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 大束給媽媽，另外兩小束。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All three are from the whole family.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl θri ɑr frəm ðə hoʊl ˈfæməli/
dialogue.zh: 三束都是全家人一起送的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Family bunches carry more love per stem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfæməli ˈbʌntʃɪz ˈkæri mɔr lʌv pɚ stɛm/
dialogue.zh: 全家一起送的花，每枝愛更多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The third bunch is not a birthday one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə θɜrd bʌntʃ ɪz nɑt ə ˈbɜrθˌdeɪ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 第三束不是慶生的那一種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A get-well bunch needs quiet colors.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˌɡɛtˈwɛl bʌntʃ nidz ˈkwaɪət ˈkʌlɚz/
dialogue.zh: 祝她康復的花束要有安靜的顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I say the party is at her home?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd aɪ seɪ ðə ˈpɑɚti ɪz ət hɜr hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 我有說過派對是在她家裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did. Balcony, early evening, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dɪd ˈbælkəni ˈɜrli ˈivnɪŋ raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 說過，在陽台，傍晚，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Start with Mother's bunch, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt wɪð ˈmʌðɚz bʌntʃ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那就先從媽媽那束開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will tell you what each one means.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl tɛl ju wʌt itʃ wʌn minz/
dialogue.zh: 我會告訴你每一種花的含意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me about the white roses first.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi əˈbaʊt ðə waɪt ˈroʊzɪz fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 先跟我說說白玫瑰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: White roses speak of deep respect.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪt ˈroʊzɪz spik əv dip rɪˈspɛkt/
dialogue.zh: 白玫瑰說的是深深的尊敬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Respect is exactly my feeling.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈspɛkt ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli maɪ ˈfilɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 尊敬正是我的心意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then your mother will read it clearly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jɔr ˈmʌðɚ wɪl rid ɪt ˈklɪrli/
dialogue.zh: 那你媽媽一看就讀得懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do red roses only say love?
dialogue.phonetic: /du rɛd ˈroʊzɪz ˈoʊnli seɪ lʌv/
dialogue.zh: 紅玫瑰只在說愛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Red is for a partner, not a parent.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛd ɪz fɚ ə ˈpɑrtnɚ nɑt ə ˈpɛrənt/
dialogue.zh: 紅色是給伴侶的，不是給父母的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a useful line to know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ˈjufəl laɪn tə noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 這句話很有用，我記下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I tell that to most customers here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tɛl ðæt tə moʊst ˈkʌstəmərz hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 我在這裡對大多數客人都這麼說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Carnations for a mother — what is their message?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrˈneɪʃənz fɚ ə ˈmʌðɚ wʌt ɪz ðɛr ˈmɛsɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 給媽媽的康乃馨代表什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pink carnations mean a mother's kindness.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪŋk kɑrˈneɪʃənz min ə ˈmʌðɚz ˈkaɪndnəs/
dialogue.zh: 粉紅康乃馨代表媽媽的恩情。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kindness stays with me today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkaɪndnəs steɪz wɪð mi təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那份恩情今天還留在我身上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That flower has carried it for years.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈflaʊɚ həz ˈkærid ɪt fɚ jɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 那種花已經替人背了許多年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are lilies only for sad rooms?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ˈlɪliz ˈoʊnli fɚ sæd rumz/
dialogue.zh: 百合只能用在悲傷的場合嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They wish peace to a tired heart.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɪʃ pis tə ə ˈtaɪərd hɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 它們是祝疲憊的心平靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peace would help my cousin now.
dialogue.phonetic: /pis wʊd hɛlp maɪ ˈkʌzən naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 平靜現在對表妹有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then one lily with no strong smell.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wʌn ˈlɪli wɪð noʊ strɔŋ smɛl/
dialogue.zh: 那就一枝氣味不濃的百合。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do tulips carry a message, too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ˈtulɪps ˈkæri ə ˈmɛsɪdʒ tu/
dialogue.zh: 鬱金香也有心意嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tulips say, I am thinking of you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtulɪps seɪ aɪ æm ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əv ju/
dialogue.zh: 鬱金香說的是，我在想你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thinking of you fits my mother, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əv ju fɪts maɪ ˈmʌðɚ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 想念你正合我媽媽的心意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two tulips for her, not a dozen.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈtulɪps fɚ hɚ nɑt ə ˈdʌzən/
dialogue.zh: 給她兩枝鬱金香，不要一打。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunflowers — what do they tell us?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌnˌflaʊɚz wʌt du ðeɪ tɛl əs/
dialogue.zh: 向日葵在告訴我們什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They say, keep facing the bright side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ seɪ kip ˈfeɪsɪŋ ðə braɪt saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 它們說，要一直朝著亮的那面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mother needs that sentence.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈmʌðɚ nidz ðæt ˈsɛntəns/
dialogue.zh: 我媽媽需要那句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put one sunflower high in the middle.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt wʌn ˈsʌnˌflaʊɚ haɪ ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl/
dialogue.zh: 把一枝向日葵放在中間高處。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Won't the sunflower cover the carnations?
dialogue.phonetic: /wont ðə ˈsʌnˌflaʊɚ ˈkʌvɚ ðə kɑrˈneɪʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 向日葵不會擋到康乃馨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if it sits too low.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ɪt sɪts tu loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 只有在它插得太低時才會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And daisies? Are those just filler?
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd ˈdeɪziz ɑr ðoz dʒʌst ˈfɪlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那雛菊呢？只是補空缺的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Daisies say, simple days are good days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdeɪziz seɪ ˈsɪmpəl deɪz ɑr ɡʊd deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 雛菊說，平凡的日子是好日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the right thought for Mrs. Chen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə raɪt θɔt fɚ ˈmɪsɪz tʃɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那正是我想對陳太太說的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her thank you needs no big words.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɚ θæŋk ju nidz noʊ bɪɡ wɜrdz/
dialogue.zh: 她那句謝謝不需要大字眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the color change the meaning?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈkʌlɚ tʃeɪndʒ ðə ˈminɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 顏色會改變意思嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes. Cream is softer than pure white.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs krim ɪz ˈsɔftɚ ðæn pjʊr waɪt/
dialogue.zh: 會，奶油色比純白更柔軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Purple? What does a purple stem say?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrpəl wʌt dʌz ə ˈpɜrpəl stɛm seɪ/
dialogue.zh: 紫色？紫色的花枝說什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Purple honors an older person best.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrpəl ˈɑnɚz ən ˈoʊldɚ ˈpɜrsən bɛst/
dialogue.zh: 紫色最表達對長輩的敬意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty is older, then a little purple.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti ɪz ˈoʊldɚ ðɛn ə ˈlɪtəl ˈpɜrpəl/
dialogue.zh: 六十歲算年長了，那加點紫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two purple tulips, and no more.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈpɜrpəl ˈtulɪps ənd noʊ mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 兩枝紫鬱金香，不要再多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But her bunch has one yellow sunflower.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt hɚ bʌntʃ hæz wʌn ˈjɛloʊ ˈsʌnˌflaʊɚ/
dialogue.zh: 可是她那束有一枝黃色向日葵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One sunflower is a smile, not a shout.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈsʌnˌflaʊɚ ɪz ə smaɪl nɑt ə ʃaʊt/
dialogue.zh: 一枝向日葵是笑容，不是大嗓門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So yellow is fine for the neighbor?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈjɛloʊ ɪz faɪn fɚ ðə ˈneɪbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那黃色給鄰居就可以囉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Pale yellow says friendly thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt peɪl ˈjɛloʊ sɛz ˈfrɛndli θæŋks/
dialogue.zh: 剛好，淡黃說的是友好的謝意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about orange? Too loud, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ˈɔrɪndʒ tu laʊd aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 橙色呢？我覺得太吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Orange shouts energy and party noise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔrɪndʒ ʃaʊts ˈɛnɚdʒi ənd ˈpɑrti nɔɪz/
dialogue.zh: 橙色會大喊活力和派對的吵聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then orange stays off all three bunches.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈɔrɪndʒ steɪz ɔf ɔl θri ˈbʌntʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 那三束都不要放橙色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Every message is already full.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈɛvri ˈmɛsɪdʒ ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi fʊl/
dialogue.zh: 好，三份心意已經夠滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do orchids mean anything for a mother?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ˈɔrkɪdz min ˈɛniθɪŋ fɚ ə ˈmʌðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 蘭花對媽媽有什麼含意嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Orchids wish a long, calm life.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔrkɪdz wɪʃ ə lɔŋ kɑm laɪf/
dialogue.zh: 蘭花許的是長而安定的生活。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Long life is a good birthday wish.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔŋ laɪf ɪz ə ɡʊd ˈbɚθˌdeɪ wɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 長壽是很好的生日願望。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One orchid carries that without noise.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈɔrkɪd ˈkæriz ðæt wɪˈðaʊt nɔɪz/
dialogue.zh: 一枝蘭花就能不張揚地送到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is an orchid too fancy for her?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ən ˈɔrkɪd tu ˈfænsi fɚ hɚ/
dialogue.zh: 蘭花對她會不會太高級？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She will love one. Trust me here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɪl lʌv wʌn trʌst mi hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 她會喜歡那一枝，相信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Baby's breath — what does that say?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbeɪbiz brɛθ wʌt dʌz ðæt seɪ/
dialogue.zh: 滿天星說的是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says, I stay right here with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz aɪ steɪ raɪt hɪr wɪð ju/
dialogue.zh: 它說，我就陪在你身邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Filler flowers can carry that weight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪlɚ ˈflaʊɚz kən ˈkæri ðæt weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 補白的花也能承載那麼重？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small stems often say the most.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl stɛmz ˈɔfən seɪ ðə moʊst/
dialogue.zh: 小枝常常講得最多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eucalyptus has a meaning, too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌjukəˈlɪptəs həz ə ˈminɪŋ tu/
dialogue.zh: 尤加利也有含意嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Its leaves stand for healing and care.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts livz stænd fɚ ˈhilɪŋ ənd kɛr/
dialogue.zh: 它的葉子代表療癒與照顧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Healing is right for the hospital bunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhilɪŋ ɪz raɪt fɚ ðə ˈhɑspɪtəl bʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 療癒正好是那束醫院要的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuck two sprigs behind her daisies.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʌk tu sprɪɡz bɪˈhaɪnd hɚ ˈdeɪziz/
dialogue.zh: 把兩小枝塞進她的雛菊後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do peonies say anything at a birthday?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ˈpiəniz seɪ ˈɛniθɪŋ ət ə ˈbɚθˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 牡丹在生日場合說什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Peonies wish a full, happy home life.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpiəniz wɪʃ ə fʊl ˈhæpi hoʊm laɪf/
dialogue.zh: 牡丹許的是美滿幸福的家庭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peonies are not here right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpiəniz ɑr nɑt hɪr raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 牡丹現在店裡沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No. They open only in late spring.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðeɪ ˈoʊpən ˈoʊnli ɪn leɪt sprɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對，它們只在春末開放。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spring flowers in autumn feel wrong.
dialogue.phonetic: /sprɪŋ ˈflaʊɚz ɪn ˈɔtəm fil rɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 秋天買春天的花，感覺不對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed. Out of season, out of heart.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid aʊt əv ˈsizən aʊt əv hɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 同意，反季就少了那份真心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does lavender say in a bunch?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dʌz ˈlævəndɚ seɪ ɪn ə bʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 薰衣草在花束裡說的是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It asks everyone to slow down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt æsks ˈɛvriwʌn tə sloʊ daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 它在請每一個人慢下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slow down is what Mother needs.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ daʊn ɪz wʌt ˈmʌðɚ nidz/
dialogue.zh: 慢下來正是媽媽需要的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then one small lavender sprig, no more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wʌn smɔl ˈlævəndɚ sprɪɡ noʊ mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 那就一小枝薰衣草，不要多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the number of stems mean things?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈnʌmbɚ əv stɛmz min θɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 枝數也有說法嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Odd counts read warmer here, usually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑd kaʊnts rid ˈwɔrmɚ hɪr ˈjuʒəwəli/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡單數看起來比較暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So nine stems, not eight?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ naɪn stɛmz nɑt eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那用九枝，不用八枝？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine for her, three for Mrs. Chen.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn fɚ hɚ θri fɚ ˈmɪsɪz tʃɛn/
dialogue.zh: 給她九枝，陳太太三枝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three feels small for a whole month.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri filz smɔl fɚ ə hoʊl mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 三枝感覺配不上一整個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small and honest beats big and empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ənd ˈɑnɪst bits bɪɡ ənd ˈɛmpi/
dialogue.zh: 小而真誠，勝過大而不實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Empty bunches exist? How do you know?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛmpi ˈbʌntʃɪz ɪɡˈzɪst haʊ du ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 空洞的花束也存在？你怎麼知道？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too many stems, no feeling at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɛni stɛmz noʊ ˈfilɪŋ ət ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 枝數太多，卻一點感覺都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a sentence I will keep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ˈsɛntəns aɪ wɪl kip/
dialogue.zh: 這句話我要留在心裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it for your own birthday, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt fɚ jɔr on ˈbɜrθˌdeɪ tu/
dialogue.zh: 也留給你自己的生日吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do thorns change a flower's message?
dialogue.phonetic: /du θɔrnz tʃeɪndʒ ə ˈflaʊɚz ˈmɛsɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 花刺會改變花的訊息嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roses still say love, thorns or not.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈroʊzɪz stɪl seɪ lʌv θɔrnz ɔr nɑt/
dialogue.zh: 有刺沒刺，玫瑰都還是說愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are thornless roses a weaker gift?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ˈθɔrnlɪs ˈroʊzɪz ə ˈwikɚ ɡɪft/
dialogue.zh: 無刺的玫瑰禮物比較弱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No. The meaning sits in the color.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə ˈminɪŋ sɪts ɪn ðə ˈkʌlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 不會，心意住在顏色裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which flower says missing someone most?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈflaʊɚ sɛz ˈmɪsɪŋ ˈsʌmwʌn moʊst/
dialogue.zh: 哪種花最會說想念一個人？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forget me nots say it plainly.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚˈɡɛt mi nɑts seɪ ɪt ˈpleɪnli/
dialogue.zh: 勿忘我最直白地說了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those tiny blue ones by the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoz ˈtaɪni blu wʌnz baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 門口那些小小的藍色花嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes. They cost almost nothing, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðeɪ kɔst ˈɔlmoʊst ˈnʌθɪŋ ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 對，不過它們幾乎不花錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add five to my mother's bunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd faɪv tə maɪ ˈmʌðɚz bʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 在我媽媽那束加五枝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For the father she lost, maybe?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ ðə ˈfɑðɚ ʃi lɔst ˈmeɪbi/
dialogue.zh: 是為了她失去的爸爸嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes. He liked blue more than red.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hi laɪkt blu mɔr ðæn rɛd/
dialogue.zh: 是，他喜歡藍色多過紅色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then five blue stems, quietly placed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn faɪv blu stɛmz ˈkwaɪətli pleɪst/
dialogue.zh: 那就五枝藍色，輕輕放進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You read people through their flowers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju rid ˈpipəl θru ðɛr ˈflaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 你從一個人的花看出那個人的心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty years at this counter does that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti jɪrz ət ðɪs ˈkaʊntɚ dʌz ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 在這個櫃台站了二十年就會了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last meaning question, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst ˈminɪŋ ˈkwɛstʃən pliz/
dialogue.zh: 最後一個關於含意的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask it. I have my shears ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ɪt aɪ hæv maɪ ʃɪrz ˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 你問，我的剪刀已經備好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do tight buds say something different?
dialogue.phonetic: /du taɪt bʌdz seɪ ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈdɪfrənt/
dialogue.zh: 閉著的花苞說的不一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buds promise something still to come.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌdz ˈprɑmɪs ˈsʌmθɪŋ stɪl tə kʌm/
dialogue.zh: 花苞承諾還有東西會來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do flowers keep their meaning when dried?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ˈflaʊɚz kip ðɛr ˈminɪŋ wɛn draɪd/
dialogue.zh: 花乾了之後還有含意嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but quieter and much slower.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt ˈkwaɪətɚ ənd mʌtʃ ˈsloʊɚ/
dialogue.zh: 有，只是更安靜、更慢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slow and quiet suits her fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ ənd ˈkwaɪət suts hɚ faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 慢又安靜，很合她的性子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Now the size and the count.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naʊ ðə saɪz ənd ðə kaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 好，接下來談大小和枝數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us count the stems out loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt əs kaʊnt ðə stɛmz aʊt laʊd/
dialogue.zh: 我們把枝數大聲數一數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure. Point at each one you add.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr pɔɪnt ət itʃ wʌn ju æd/
dialogue.zh: 好，你加一枝就指一枝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine carnations, cream and blush.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn kɑrˈneɪʃənz krim ənd blʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 九枝康乃馨，奶油色和腮紅色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a warm base, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə wɔrm beɪs jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 那是一個很暖的底。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blush is that very pale pink?
dialogue.phonetic: /blʌʃ ɪz ðæt ˈvɛri peɪl pɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 腮紅色是那很淡的粉紅嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the soft one on the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə sɔft wʌn ɑn ðə lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 對，左手邊最柔和的那束。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The left bunch has twenty stems?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɛft bʌntʃ həz ˈtwɛnti stɛmz/
dialogue.zh: 左邊那束有二十枝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seventeen now, three went this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvəntin naʊ θri wɛnt ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 現在十七枝，早上賣掉三枝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then take the three freshest ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn teɪk ðə θri ˈfrɛʃɪst wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 那就拿最新鮮的那三枝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, petals tight, no brown edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ˈpɛtəlz taɪt noʊ braʊn ɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 這裡，花瓣緊，邊緣不褐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two cream roses at the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu krim ˈroʊzɪz ət ðə tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 上面放兩枝奶油玫瑰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Top or middle? Middle holds them better.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɑp ɔr ˈmɪdəl ˈmɪdəl hoʊldz ðɛm ˈbɛtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 上面還是中間？中間比較穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Middle, so they face the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪdəl soʊ ðeɪ feɪs ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 中間，讓它們對著門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. They meet her at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðeɪ mit hɚ ət ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 好，她一開門就與花相遇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How tall will the bunch stand?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ tɔl wɪl ðə bʌntʃ stænd/
dialogue.zh: 這束會站多高？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About one foot, easy on her table.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt wʌn fʊt ˈizi ɑn hɚ ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 大約一尺，在她桌上剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A shorter one suits her table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈʃɔrtɚ wʌn suts hɚ ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 矮一點的更適合她的桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I cut every stem lower.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ kʌt ˈɛvri stɛm ˈloʊɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那我把每枝都剪低。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cut them, yes. Her vase is low.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌt ðɛm jɛs hɚ veɪz ɪz loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 剪短對，她的花瓶很低。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Low vase, short stems. Easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /loʊ veɪz ʃɔrt stɛmz ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 低花瓶配短枝，簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add greenery, but only a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ˈɡrinəri bʌt ˈoʊnli ə ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 加點綠葉，但只要一點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two eucalyptus sprigs frame it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˌjukəˈlɪptəs sprɪɡz freɪm ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 兩枝尤加利就能框住它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three colors in one bunch, too many?
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈkʌlɚz ɪn wʌn bʌntʃ tu ˈmɛni/
dialogue.zh: 一束三種顏色，太多了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three is the safe maximum, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ɪz ðə seɪf ˈmæksəməm ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 誠實說，三色是安全上限。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So cream, blush, and one purple.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ krim blʌʃ ənd wʌn ˈpɜrpəl/
dialogue.zh: 那就奶油、腮紅，加一枝紫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes. Purple on the outer ring.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈpɜrpəl ɑn ðə ˈaʊtɚ rɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對，紫色放外圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Outer ring, not the center, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊtɚ rɪŋ nɑt ðə ˈsɛntɚ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 外圈，不是中心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right. The center stays soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðə ˈsɛntɚ steɪz sɔft/
dialogue.zh: 對了，中心維持柔軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the numbers have to be odd?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə ˈnʌmbɚz hæv tə bi ɑd/
dialogue.zh: 枝數一定要是單數嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Odd numbers look looser, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑd ˈnʌmbɚz lʊk ˈlusɚ ˈtruli/
dialogue.zh: 單數看起來比較鬆，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nineteen for a big birthday?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪnˈtin fɚ ə bɪɡ ˈbɜrθˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 大生日要用十九枝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nineteen fills a wide bunch well.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪnˈtin fɪlz ə waɪd bʌntʃ wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 十九枝剛好把大束填滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nineteen then, with the sunflower.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪnˈtin ðɛn wɪð ðə ˈsʌnˌflaʊɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那就十九枝，含向日葵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sunflower counts as one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsʌnˌflaʊɚ kaʊnts æz wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 向日葵算一枝在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does one sunflower balance nineteen?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz wʌn ˈsʌnˌflaʊɚ ˈbæləns naɪnˈtin/
dialogue.zh: 一枝向日葵壓得住十九枝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if it sits slightly higher.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪf ɪt sɪts ˈslaɪtli ˈhaɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，如果它稍微高一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slightly higher, not tower high.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈslaɪtli ˈhaɪɚ nɑt ˈtaʊɚ haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 稍微高，不要像塔那樣高。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just two fingers above the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst tu ˈfɪŋɡɚz əˈbʌv ðə rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 高出其他的兩指就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two fingers. I can picture that.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈfɪŋɡɚz aɪ kən ˈpɪktʃɚ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 兩指，我想像得出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Picture it round, like a small hill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɪktʃɚ ɪt raʊnd laɪk ə smɔl hɪl/
dialogue.zh: 把它想成圓圓的小山丘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Round is her favorite shape.
dialogue.phonetic: /raʊnd ɪz hɚ ˈfeɪvərɪt ʃeɪp/
dialogue.zh: 圓形是她最愛的形狀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I spiral the stems slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ ˈspaɪrəl ðə stɛmz ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 那我慢慢把枝繞成螺旋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spiral? Show me with one stem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈspaɪrəl ʃoʊ mi wɪð wʌn stɛm/
dialogue.zh: 螺旋？用一枝示範給我看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch this stem turn as I lift it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ðɪs stɛm tɜrn æz aɪ lɪft ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 看這枝怎麼隨我抬高而轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see. Each one leans a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si itʃ wʌn linz ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我明白了，每枝都斜一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bit is enough for the round shape.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɪt ɪz ɪˈnʌf fɚ ðə raʊnd ʃeɪp/
dialogue.zh: 一點點就夠做出圓形了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take out that bruised one, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk aʊt ðæt bruzd wʌn pliz/
dialogue.zh: 把那枝撞傷的拿出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good eye. That petal was already bent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ ðæt ˈpɛtəl wʌz ɔlˈrɛdi bɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 好眼力，那片花瓣早彎了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry about the extra work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri əˈbaʊt ði ˈɛkstrə wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉多花了工。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not a problem. Fresh ones are behind.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ə ˈprɑbləm frɛʃ wʌnz ɑr bɪˈhaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 不難，新鮮的就在後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Behind? Are those even better?
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈhaɪnd ɑr ðoz ˈivən ˈbɛtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 後面那些更好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two days younger, same price each.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu deɪz ˈjʌŋɚ seɪm praɪs itʃ/
dialogue.zh: 年輕兩天，單價一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Swap three then, if it is allowed.
dialogue.phonetic: /swɑp θri ðɛn ɪf ɪt ɪz əˈlaʊd/
dialogue.zh: 可以的話換掉三枝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Allowed and normal. Take the younger.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlaʊd ənd ˈnɔrməl teɪk ðə ˈjʌŋɚ/
dialogue.zh: 可以也很平常，拿年輕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three whites for the hospital bunch, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri waɪts fɚ ðə ˈhɑspɪtəl bʌntʃ pliz/
dialogue.zh: 三枝白色的給醫院那束，麻煩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: White daisies or white roses?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪt ˈdeɪzɪz ɔr waɪt ˈroʊzɪz/
dialogue.zh: 白雛菊還是白玫瑰？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Daisies, and two green sprigs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdeɪzɪz ənd tu ɡrin sprɪɡz/
dialogue.zh: 雛菊，再加兩小枝綠葉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five stems, plus that one pale lily.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv stɛmz plʌs ðæt wʌn peɪl ˈlɪli/
dialogue.zh: 五枝，再加上那枝淡百合。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One string is enough for her?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn strɪŋ ɪz ɪˈnʌf fɚ hɚ/
dialogue.zh: 一條繩對她就夠了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One tight tie, then the paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn taɪt taɪ ðɛn ðə ˈpeɪpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 綁緊一道，接著包裝紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How tight? My hand is not strong.
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ taɪt maɪ hænd ɪz nɑt strɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 多緊？我的手沒什麼力氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tight enough to hold, soft enough to breathe.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪt ɪˈnʌf tə hoʊld sɔft ɪˈnʌf tə brið/
dialogue.zh: 緊到綁得住，鬆到能呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soft enough to breathe. I like that.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft ɪˈnʌf tə brið aɪ laɪk ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 鬆到能呼吸，我喜歡這句。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flowers drink air as much as water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈflaʊɚz drɪŋk ɛr æz mʌtʃ æz ˈwɔtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 花喝的空氣和水一樣多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? Air as much as water?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪli ɛr æz mʌtʃ æz ˈwɔtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？空氣跟水一樣多？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In a warm room, yes, very much.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ə wɔrm rum jɛs ˈvɛri mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 在溫暖的房間，對，很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our home is warm in the afternoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊɚ hoʊm ɪz wɔrm ɪn ði ˌæftərˈnun/
dialogue.zh: 我們家下午都很暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then keep them off the sunny side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kip ðɛm ɔf ðə ˈsʌni saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 那就把它們移離日照那側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count the neighbor's stems again.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt ðə ˈneɪbɚz stɛmz əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 再數一次鄰居那束的枝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One, two, three yellow daisies. Odd.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tu θri ˈjɛloʊ ˈdeɪzɪz ɑd/
dialogue.zh: 一、二、三枝黃雛菊，單數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An odd count for her, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ɑd kaʊnt fɚ hɚ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那對她就用單數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For a thank you, three is right.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ ə θæŋk ju θri ɪz raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 道謝的花，三枝剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. The count follows the message, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðə kaʊnt fɑloʊz ðə ˈmɛsɪdʒ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 好，枝數跟著心意走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always. The meaning comes first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlweɪz ðə ˈminɪŋ kʌmz fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 一直如此，含意排第一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: White mixed in, is that allowed?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪt mɪkst ɪn ɪz ðæt əˈlaʊd/
dialogue.zh: 混一點白進去，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little white opens the whole shape.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtl waɪt ˈoʊpənz ðə hoʊl ʃeɪp/
dialogue.zh: 一點白會讓整個形狀鬆開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add two blush stems to her bunch?
dialogue.phonetic: /æd tu blʌʃ stɛmz tə hɚ bʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 她那束加兩枝腮紅好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that lifts it without noise.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæt lɪfts ɪt wɪˈðaʊt nɔɪz/
dialogue.zh: 可以，那會提起來又不吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No noise, no shine, nothing gold.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ nɔɪz noʊ ʃaɪn ˈnʌθɪŋ ɡoʊld/
dialogue.zh: 不吵、不亮、也不要金色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed. Gold foil is for shop windows.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid ɡoʊld fɔɪl ɪz fɚ ʃɑp ˈwɪndoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 同意，金箔是給櫥窗的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The window bunch has how many?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɪndoʊ bʌntʃ həz haʊ ˈmɛni/
dialogue.zh: 櫥窗那束有幾枝？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifty, and it is only for show.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti ənd ɪt ɪz ˈoʊnli fɚ ʃoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 五十枝，只是擺好看的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For show only? So I should not copy it.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ ʃoʊ ˈoʊnli soʊ aɪ ʃʊd nɑt ˈkɑpi ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 只是好看？那我不該照抄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Copy the feeling, not the count.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑpi ðə ˈfilɪŋ nɑt ðə kaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 抄那份感覺，不要抄枝數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is my kind of advice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz maɪ kaɪnd əv ædˈvaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 這正是我喜歡的建議。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take nine. Nine holds a story.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk naɪn naɪn hoʊldz ə ˈstɔri/
dialogue.zh: 拿九枝，九枝撐得起故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine carnations, then two cream roses.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn kɑrˈneɪʃənz ðɛn tu krim ˈroʊzɪz/
dialogue.zh: 九枝康乃馨，再加兩枝奶油玫瑰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eleven so far, warm and unhurried.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈlɛvən soʊ fɑr wɔrm ənd ʌnˈhɜrid/
dialogue.zh: 目前十一枝，溫暖又不趕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Unhurried is a good word for her.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌnˈhɜrid ɪz ə ɡʊd wɜrd fɚ hɚ/
dialogue.zh: 不趕，是很適合她的形容。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is also the look I aimed for.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈɔlsoʊ ðə lʊk aɪ emd fɔr/
dialogue.zh: 那也是我想要營造的樣子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you aim it? I thought I did.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju em ɪt aɪ θɔt aɪ dɪd/
dialogue.zh: 是你排的？我以為是我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Together, then. Nineteen stems, done.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈɡɛðɚ ðɛn naɪnˈtin stɛmz dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 那是一起排的，十九枝，完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the tie point, high or low?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə taɪ pɔɪnt haɪ ɔr loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 綁的位置，高還是低？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Low, so the flowers spread on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /loʊ soʊ ðə ˈflaʊɚz sprɛd ɑn tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 綁低，花才會在上方散開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spread on top. That is the look.
dialogue.phonetic: /sprɛd ɑn tɑp ðæt ɪz ðə lʊk/
dialogue.zh: 在上方散開，就是那個樣子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And one hand can hold all of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd wʌn hænd kən hoʊld ɔl əv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 而且一隻手就捧得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hand. My other hand has the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn hænd maɪ ˈʌðɚ hænd həz ðə kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 一隻手，另一隻手拿卡片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Card comes later, after the paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrd kʌmz ˈleɪtɚ ˈæftɚ ðə ˈpeɪpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 卡片之後，先包好紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before the paper, we need one number.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr ðə ˈpeɪpɚ wi nid wʌn ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 包紙之前，我們要先有個數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your budget? I can work inside it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈbʌdʒɪt aɪ kən wɜrk ɪnˈsaɪd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你的預算嗎？我能在裡面配。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My budget is forty dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈbʌdʒɪt ɪz ˈfɔrti ˈdɑlɚz/
dialogue.zh: 我的預算四十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty builds a solid bunch here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti bɪldz ə ˈsɑlɪd bʌntʃ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 四十元在這裡能紮一束結實的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Solid means nineteen stems, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑlɪd minz naɪnˈtin stɛmz raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 扎實是十九枝的意思嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With local flowers, yes, nineteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð ˈloʊkəl ˈflaʊɚz jɛs naɪnˈtin/
dialogue.zh: 用本地的花，可以，十九枝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Local flowers? Are those from nearby?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈloʊkəl ˈflaʊɚz ɑr ðoz frəm ˈnɪrbaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 本地的花？是附近種的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hours away, cut late last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈaʊərz əˈweɪ kʌt leɪt læst naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 兩小時車程，昨夜很晚剪下的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last night. That is very fresh.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst naɪt ðæt ɪz ˈvɛri frɛʃ/
dialogue.zh: 昨晚剪的，非常新鮮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh, and cheaper than imported roses.
dialogue.phonetic: /frɛʃ ənd ˈtʃipɚ ðæn ˌɪmˈpɔrtəd ˈroʊzɪz/
dialogue.zh: 又新鮮，比進口玫瑰便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Imported roses cost how much?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌɪmˈpɔrtəd ˈroʊzɪz kɔst haʊ mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 進口玫瑰一枝多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five dollars each, sometimes six.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈdɑlɚz itʃ ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 一枝五元，有時六元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six for one rose. No, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks fɚ wʌn roʊz noʊ θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 一枝六元？那不要，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed. Local cream roses are two.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid ˈloʊkəl krim ˈroʊzɪz ɑr tu/
dialogue.zh: 同意。本地奶油玫瑰二元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two each. Two roses, then: four dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu itʃ tu ˈroʊzɪz ðɛn fɔr ˈdɑlɚz/
dialogue.zh: 一枝二元，兩枝玫瑰共四元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Carnations and greenery make the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrˈneɪʃənz ənd ˈɡrinəri meɪk ðə rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 康乃馨和綠葉算剩下的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does that total come to?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dʌz ðæt ˈtoʊtəl kʌm tu/
dialogue.zh: 這樣總計是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen dollars, before the wrapping.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪfˈtin ˈdɑlɚz bɪˈfɔr ðə ˈræpɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 十五元，還不含包裝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifteen? I still have half my money.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪfˈtin aɪ stɪl hæv hæf maɪ ˈmʌni/
dialogue.zh: 十五元？我錢還剩一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, so let the bunch rest there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs soʊ lɛt ðə bʌntʃ rɛst ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 對，所以花束就到這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rest there means stop adding stems?
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst ðɛr minz stɑp ˈædɪŋ stɛmz/
dialogue.zh: 到這裡是不能再加枝了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop at nineteen, or you overdo it.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑp ət naɪnˈtin ɔr ju ˌoʊvɚˈdu ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 停十九枝，再多加就過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Overdoing is easy with flowers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌoʊvɚˈduɪŋ ɪz ˈizi wɪð ˈflaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 花很容易加過頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too many stems look like a market.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɛni stɛmz lʊk laɪk ə ˈmɑrkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 枝數太多會像路邊菜市。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A market! My aunt loved market bunches.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈmɑrkɪt maɪ ænt lʌvd ˈmɑrkɪt ˈbʌntʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 菜市！我阿姨最愛菜市的那種大束。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big loose bunches, cheap and loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ lus ˈbʌntʃɪz tʃip ənd laʊd/
dialogue.zh: 大把又鬆，便宜又張揚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She liked loud. Mother likes quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi laɪkt laʊd ˈmʌðɚ laɪks ˈkwaɪət/
dialogue.zh: 她喜歡張揚，媽媽喜歡安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then nineteen quiet stems is right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn naɪnˈtin ˈkwaɪət stɛmz ɪz raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那十九枝安靜的剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you build the bunch for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən ju bɪld ðə bʌntʃ fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 你能替我把束配好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Within forty? I can do exactly that.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪˈðɪn ˈfɔrti aɪ kən du ɪɡˈzæktli ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 四十以內？我正可以做到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do. I am bad at counting.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du aɪ æm bæd ət ˈkaʊntɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 麻煩你了，我不會數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Counting is my job, you pick colors.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkaʊntɪŋ ɪz maɪ dʒɑb ju pɪk ˈkʌlɚz/
dialogue.zh: 數數是我的工作，你挑顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I pick, you count. That feels safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pɪk ju kaʊnt ðæt filz seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 我挑色，你數枝，這樣安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Safe is the word for a gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪf ɪz ðə wɜrd fɚ ə ɡɪft/
dialogue.zh: 安心正是禮物該有的字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the two small bunches cheaper?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə tu smɔl ˈbʌntʃɪz ˈtʃipɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那兩小束比較便宜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six each. The two make twelve.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks itʃ ðə tu meɪk twɛlv/
dialogue.zh: 各六元，兩束共十二元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifteen plus twelve is twenty-seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪfˈtin plʌs twɛlv ɪz ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 十五加十二，正好二十七元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-seven, plus paper and ribbon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvən plʌs ˈpeɪpɚ ənd ˈrɪbən/
dialogue.zh: 二十七，再加紙和緞帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper and ribbon cost extra?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpɚ ənd ˈrɪbən kɔst ˈɛkstrə/
dialogue.zh: 包裝紙和緞帶要另外錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plain paper is free here, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪn ˈpeɪpɚ ɪz fri hɪr ˈɔlweɪz/
dialogue.zh: 素色紙在這裡永遠免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free is a lovely word today.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ɪz ə ˈlʌvli wɜrd təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 免費是今天動聽的詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ribbon costs one dollar more, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪbən kɔsts wʌn ˈdɑlɚ mɔr ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不過緞帶要加一元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One dollar for a satin bow?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈdɑlɚ fɚ ə ˈsætn baʊ/
dialogue.zh: 一元買一個緞帶蝴蝶結？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, or choose the simple jute string.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɔr tʃuz ðə ˈsɪmpəl dʒut strɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對，或者選單純的麻繩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Jute string. That is the free one?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒut strɪŋ ðæt ɪz ðə fri wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 麻繩，那個是不用錢的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Included, yes. It looks honest, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈklʊdɪd jɛs ɪt lʊks ˈɑnɪst tu/
dialogue.zh: 包含在內，它看起來也實在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honest suits my sister's taste.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnɪst suts maɪ ˈsɪstɚz teɪst/
dialogue.zh: 實在很合我姊姊的品味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then jute for all three bunches today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn dʒut fɚ ɔl θri ˈbʌntʃɪz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那今天三束都用麻繩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All three. So twenty-seven dollars, final?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl θri soʊ ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvən ˈdɑlɚz ˈfaɪnəl/
dialogue.zh: 三束都要，那二十七元定案？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-seven, and no delivery yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvən ənd noʊ dɪˈlɪvɚi jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 二十七元，送貨還沒算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Delivery is a separate thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈlɪvɚi ɪz ə ˈsɛpərət θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 送貨是另外一件事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six dollars inside the city today.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈdɑlɚz ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈsɪti təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天市區內六元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six is fine. I will decide later.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ɪz faɪn aɪ wɪl dɪˈsaɪd ˈleɪtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 六元沒問題，我再決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take them today, save the six.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðɛm təˈdeɪ seɪv ðə sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 今天自己帶走，省六元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Save the six. That is tempting.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv ðə sɪks ðæt ɪz ˈtɛmptɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 省六元，這很誘人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your hands are the cheap transport.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr hændz ɑr ðə tʃip ˈtrænspɔrt/
dialogue.zh: 你的雙手就是便宜交通工具。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheap transport, my favorite kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃip ˈtrænspɔrt maɪ ˈfeɪvɚɪt kaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 便宜的運輸，我最愛的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bus is cheaper than any taxi.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bʌs ɪz ˈtʃipɚ ðæn ˈɛni ˈtæksi/
dialogue.zh: 公車比任何計程車都便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True. The bus stop is outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru ðə bʌs stɑp ɪz ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 真的，公車站牌就在外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two minutes from my front door.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɪnɪts frəm maɪ frʌnt dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 離我店門口只兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Nothing more on the bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ˈnʌθɪŋ mɔr ɑn ðə bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，單子上沒別的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing more unless you add a card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ mɔr ɪnˈlɛs ju æd ə kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 除非你要加卡片，就沒有別項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cards are free with flowers here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrdz ɑr fri wɪð ˈflaʊɚz hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡買花附卡片是免費？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small ones free, big ones cost three.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl wʌnz fri bɪɡ wʌnz kɔst θri/
dialogue.zh: 小卡免費，大卡三元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small card, then. Free is wise.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl kɑrd ðɛn fri ɪz waɪz/
dialogue.zh: 那就小卡，免費才聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wise, and short messages read better.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪz ənd ʃɔrt ˈmɛsɪdʒɪz rid ˈbɛtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 聰明，而且短句比較好讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My sister will pay her share.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈsɪstɚ wɪl peɪ hɚ ʃɛr/
dialogue.zh: 我姊姊會付她那份。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half of twenty-seven is thirteen fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf əv ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvən ɪz θɜrˈtin ˈfɪfti/
dialogue.zh: 二十七的一半是十三塊五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fourteen, then. She will send it.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔrˈtin ðɛn ʃi wɪl sɛnd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那就算十四元，她會轉給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or you pay, then she refunds you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr ju peɪ ðɛn ʃi ˈrifʌndz ju/
dialogue.zh: 或者你先墊，她再還你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Refunds. I will not chase her.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrifʌndz aɪ wɪl nɑt tʃeɪs hɚ/
dialogue.zh: 追款項？我不會去追她。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Family money never moves fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfæməli ˈmʌni ˈnɛvɚ muvz fæst/
dialogue.zh: 家人之間的錢從不快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It really never does, does it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈrɪli ˈnɛvɚ dʌz dʌz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 真的從來不快，是吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No. Pay today, forget by Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ peɪ təˈdeɪ fɚˈɡɛt baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對，今天付，週五就忘掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday. I can pay by phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪdeɪ aɪ kən peɪ baɪ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 週五。我可以打電話付。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Phone is fine. Cash is faster.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊn ɪz faɪn kæʃ ɪz ˈfæstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 電話也行，現金比較快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cash it is, in small notes.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæʃ ɪt ɪz ɪn smɔl noʊts/
dialogue.zh: 那就現金，用小額紙幣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can give change for a twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kən ɡɪv tʃeɪndʒ fɚ ə ˈtwɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 二十元的我可以找。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I have only larger ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ hæv ˈoʊnli ˈlɑrdʒɚ wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 好，我只有大面的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not a problem, I keep a jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ə ˈprɑbləm aɪ kip ə dʒɑr/
dialogue.zh: 不難，我有一個零錢罐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A jar of coins on the counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə dʒɑr əv kɔɪnz ɑn ðə ˈkaʊntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 櫃台上有罐硬幣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full one, from fifty years of shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /fʊl wʌn frəm ˈfɪfti jɪrz əv ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 滿滿一罐，五十年的店留下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifty years! Whose shop was first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti jɪrz huz ʃɑp wʌz fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 五十年！最早是誰的店？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My teacher's teacher, and then mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈtitʃɚz ˈtitʃɚ ənd ðɛn maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我師父的師父，然後才是我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the prices here are honest.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə ˈpraɪsɪz hɪr ɑr ˈɑnɪst/
dialogue.zh: 所以這裡的價格都老實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honest, yes. No hidden stem fees.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnɪst jɛs noʊ ˈhɪdən stɛm fiz/
dialogue.zh: 老實，沒有藏枝數的費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No hidden fees, my favorite rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈhɪdən fiz maɪ ˈfeɪvɚɪt rul/
dialogue.zh: 不藏費用，我最喜歡的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write your number on the small note.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt jɔr ˈnʌmbɚ ɑn ðə smɔl noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 把你的電話寫在小單上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty is my top, not more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti ɪz maɪ tɑp nɑt mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 四十是我的上限，不能更多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are at twenty-seven, calm down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ət ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvən kɑm daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 你才二十七元，放心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Calm. I keep going over it.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑm aɪ kip ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈoʊvɚ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 放心，我還在反覆算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add nothing more, and it is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ˈnʌθɪŋ mɔr ənd ɪt ɪz dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 別再加東西，就結算了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, then. Bundle it for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ðɛn ˈbʌndəl ɪt fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 那就結了，幫我捆好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Within forty, with thirteen dollars spare.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪˈðɪn ˈfɔrti wɪð θɜrˈtin ˈdɑlɚz spɛr/
dialogue.zh: 四十以內，還多十三元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirteen spare dollars in my pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɜrˈtin spɛr ˈdɑlɚz ɪn maɪ ˈpɑkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 口袋裡多出的十三元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enough for a bus ticket home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈnʌf fɚ ə bʌs ˈtɪkɪt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 夠買一張回家的公車票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A ticket and one cold drink.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtɪkɪt ənd wʌn koʊld drɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 一張票，加一瓶冷的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a good day's budget.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ɡʊd deɪz ˈbʌdʒɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這是一天的好預算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I planned nothing this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ plænd ˈnʌθɪŋ ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我早上什麼錢都沒規劃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You spent it well anyway, friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju spɛnt ɪt wɛl ˈɛniˌweɪ frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 但你花得很值得，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Now show me the paper wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ naʊ ʃoʊ mi ðə ˈpeɪpɚ wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 好，現在給我看包裝紙牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper wall is on your left side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpɚ wɔl ɪz ɑn jɔr lɛft saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 紙牆就在你的左手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me the papers on the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ mi ðə ˈpeɪpɚz ɑn ðə wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 給我看牆上那些包裝紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brown kraft, cream tissue, or plain white.
dialogue.phonetic: /braʊn kræft krim ˈtɪʃu ɔr pleɪn waɪt/
dialogue.zh: 牛皮棕、奶油薄紙，或素白。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kraft is that rough brown one?
dialogue.phonetic: /kræft ɪz ðæt rʌf braʊn wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 牛皮紙是那張粗的棕色嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes. It hides fingerprints, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt haɪdz ˈfɪŋɡɚˌprɪnts tu/
dialogue.zh: 對，它還會蓋掉指紋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rough paper suits daisies well.
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌf ˈpeɪpɚ suts ˈdeɪzɪz wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 粗紙很配雛菊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For Mrs. Chen, kraft is perfect.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ ˈmɪsɪz tʃɛn kræft ɪz ˈpɜrfɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 給陳太太，牛皮紙剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And for Mother? Also brown?
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd fɚ ˈmʌðɚ ˈɔlsoʊ braʊn/
dialogue.zh: 那媽媽的呢？也是棕色？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No. Cream tissue makes a soft day.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ krim ˈtɪʃu meɪks ə sɔft deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不，奶油薄紙能做出柔和的一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soft day is a nice phrase.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft deɪ ɪz ə naɪs freɪz/
dialogue.zh: 柔和的一天，這說法真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tissue holds shape without weight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɪʃu hoʊldz ʃeɪp wɪˈðaʊt weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 薄紙有形狀卻沒有重量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is plastic out of fashion here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈplæstɪk aʊt əv ˈfæʃən hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這裡不用塑膠包花了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly. Paper breathes, plastic sweats.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmostli ˈpeɪpɚ bridz ˈplæstɪk sweɪts/
dialogue.zh: 多半不用，紙會呼吸，塑膠會流汗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sweat? Do flowers get wet inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /swɛt du ˈflaʊɚz ɡɛt wɛt ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 流汗？花在裡面會濕掉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm rooms make drops under plastic.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm rumz meɪk drɑps ˈʌndɚ ˈplæstɪk/
dialogue.zh: 暖房會在塑膠下凝出水珠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then paper, no plastic, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈpeɪpɚ noʊ ˈplæstɪk pliz/
dialogue.zh: 那就用紙，不要塑膠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed. Paper on all three bunches.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid ˈpeɪpɚ ɑn ɔl θri ˈbʌntʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 好，三束都包紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wrap the wet ends first, yes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ræp ðə wɛt ɛndz fɜrst jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 先包濕的切口，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small water cup keeps them wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl ˈwɔtɚ kʌp kips ðəm wɛt/
dialogue.zh: 小水杯能讓枝頭一直濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A cup on the stems? Clever.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kʌp ɑn ðə stɛmz ˈklɛvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 枝上套杯子？聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It saves your bus seat from water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt seɪvz jɔr bʌs sit frəm ˈwɔtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 這樣公車座位就不會滴水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My seat, my clothes, my bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ sit maɪ kloʊðz maɪ bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 我的座位、衣服、包包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All safe with a tied sleeve.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl seɪf wɪð ə taɪd sliv/
dialogue.zh: 綁好的套袖讓全都安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tied sleeve. How high up the stems?
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪd sliv haʊ haɪ ʌp ðə stɛmz/
dialogue.zh: 套袖包到枝的多高？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Up to the middle, so air enters.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌp tə ðə ˈmɪdəl soʊ ɛr ˈɛntɚz/
dialogue.zh: 包到中間，這樣空氣進得去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Air enters through the paper, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛr ˈɛntɚz θru ðə ˈpeɪpɚ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 空氣從紙透進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes. Loose folds, never tight folds.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs lus foʊldz ˈnɛvɚ taɪt foʊldz/
dialogue.zh: 對，摺要鬆，不要摺緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loose folds look lazy to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /lus foʊldz lʊk ˈleɪzi tə mi/
dialogue.zh: 鬆鬆的摺看起來很懶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lazy is exactly the wish here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈleɪzi ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli ðə wɪʃ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 懶正是這裡要的心意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wish? Explain that, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɪʃ ɪkˈsplæn ðæt pliz/
dialogue.zh: 要的心意？請解釋一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tight paper makes flowers look nervous.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪt ˈpeɪpɚ meɪks ˈflaʊɚz lʊk ˈnɜrvəs/
dialogue.zh: 紙包太緊，花看起來會緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nervous flowers. That is a picture.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɜrvəs ˈflaʊɚz ðæt ɪz ə ˈpɪktʃɚ/
dialogue.zh: 緊張的花，這畫面我懂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I fold twice and hold my breath.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ foʊld twaɪs ənd hoʊld maɪ brɛθ/
dialogue.zh: 我摺兩次，同時屏住氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your breath goes into the paper?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr brɛθ ɡoʊz ˈɪntu ðə ˈpeɪpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 你的氣息也進到紙裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It settles the tissue softly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈsɛtəlz ðə ˈtɪʃu ˈsɔftli/
dialogue.zh: 那讓薄紙輕輕服貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now fold it on the diagonal.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ foʊld ɪt ɑn ðə daɪəˈɡonəl/
dialogue.zh: 現在斜著摺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Diagonal corners, or straight edges?
dialogue.phonetic: /daɪəˈɡonəl ˈkɔrnɚz ɔr streɪt ˈɛdʒɪz/
dialogue.zh: 斜角，還是直線邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Corners. Straight looks like a box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔrnɚz streɪt lʊks laɪk ə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 斜角吧，直的像紙箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True. Corners give a softer shape.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru ˈkɔrnɚz ɡɪv ə ˈsɔftɚ ʃeɪp/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，斜角形狀比較柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So one corner faces the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌn ˈkɔrnɚ ˈfeɪsɪz ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 那有一個角對著門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes. She sees it first, then you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʃi siz ɪt fɜrst ðɛn ju/
dialogue.zh: 對，她先看到角，再看到你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which string for the cream tissue?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ strɪŋ fɚ ðə krim ˈtɪʃu/
dialogue.zh: 奶油薄紙要配哪條繩子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Jute, one finger wide, no cost.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒut wʌn ˈfɪŋɡɚ waɪd noʊ kɔst/
dialogue.zh: 麻繩，一指寬，不用錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One finger wide, not two?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈfɪŋɡɚ waɪd nɑt tu/
dialogue.zh: 一指寬，不要兩指？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two fingers looks like a gift box.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈfɪŋɡɚz lʊks laɪk ə ɡɪft bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 兩指寬就像禮盒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A gift box is fine for a birthday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡɪft bɑks ɪz faɪn fɚ ə ˈbɜrθˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 生日用禮盒也可以啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The flowers are the gift, not the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈflaʊɚz ɑr ðə ɡɪft nɑt ðə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 花才是禮物，盒子不是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then jute twice round, a small bow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn dʒut twaɪs raʊnd ə smɔl baʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那就麻繩繞兩圈，打個小結。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small bow, two tails hanging down.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl baʊ tu teɪlz ˈhæŋɪŋ daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 小結，兩條尾垂下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tails, not a knot? That is softer.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪlz nɑt ə nɑt ðæt ɪz ˈsɔftɚ/
dialogue.zh: 垂尾不是死結？那樣更柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Knots are for mail, not flowers.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑts ɑr fɚ mel nɑt ˈflaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 死結是綁郵件用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mail. I never thought of that.
dialogue.phonetic: /mel aɪ ˈnɛvɚ θɔt əv ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 郵件，我從沒這樣想過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty years teach small odd rules.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti jɪrz titʃ smɔl ɑd rulz/
dialogue.zh: 二十年會教人奇怪小規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Use tape or a pin to hold it?
dialogue.phonetic: /juz teɪp ɔr ə pɪn tə hoʊld ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 用膠帶還是別針固定？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A pin, never tape on petals.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə pɪn ˈnɛvɚ teɪp ɑn ˈpɛtəlz/
dialogue.zh: 用別針，膠帶不碰花瓣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why not tape on petals?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ nɑt teɪp ɑn ˈpɛtəlz/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼膠帶不能貼花瓣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tape pulls the color off, later.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪp pʊlz ðə ˈkʌlɚ ɔf ˈleɪtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 事後膠帶會把顏色扯掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Off the color? So pale marks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔf ðə ˈkʌlɚ soʊ peɪl mɑrks/
dialogue.zh: 顏色被扯掉？變白斑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: White marks on cream. Very visible.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪt mɑrks ɑn krim ˈvɛri ˈvɪzəbl/
dialogue.zh: 奶油色上的白印，很明顯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then pin it, and check the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn pɪn ɪt ənd tʃɛk ðə bæk/
dialogue.zh: 那就別針，再檢查背面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I pin low, where no one sees.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pɪn loʊ wɛr noʊ wʌn siz/
dialogue.zh: 我別在下面，沒人看的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No one sees? Is the back ugly?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wʌn siz ɪz ðə bæk ˈʌɡli/
dialogue.zh: 沒人看？背面會難看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The back shows when she lifts it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæk ʃoʊz wɛn ʃi lɪfts ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 她舉起來時背面會露出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lifts it to her face, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪfts ɪt tə hɚ feɪs jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 舉到臉前面，是喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone turns a bunch once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriwʌn tɜrnz ə bʌntʃ wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 每個人都會把花束轉一圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So a clean back is worth it.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ə klin bæk ɪz wɜrθ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 所以背面乾淨很值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I fold the ends inside, see?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ foʊld ði ɛndz ɪnˈsaɪd si/
dialogue.zh: 我把紙邊折進去了，看？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see. Neat like a letter.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si nit laɪk ə ˈlɛtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我看到了，整齊像一封信。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A letter she will keep, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɛtɚ ʃi wɪl kip ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不過她會留著的信。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The small bunch: same paper, less folds?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɔl bʌntʃ seɪm ˈpeɪpɚ lɛs foʊldz/
dialogue.zh: 小束呢？同紙，少幾摺？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kraft once around, one jute tie.
dialogue.phonetic: /kræft wʌns əˈraʊnd wʌn dʒut taɪ/
dialogue.zh: 牛皮紙繞一圈，一條麻繩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Once around is enough for daisies?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌns əˈraʊnd ɪz ɪˈnʌf fɚ ˈdeɪzɪz/
dialogue.zh: 繞一圈就夠包雛菊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Daisies are tough, they need little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdeɪzɪz ɑr tʌf ðeɪ nid ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 雛菊很皮，不需要多包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Little, and cheap. Her bunch looks humble.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪtəl ənd tʃip hɚ bʌntʃ lʊks ˈhʌmbəl/
dialogue.zh: 少又便宜，她那束很謙和。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Humble is the right word, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhʌmbəl ɪz ðə raɪt wɜrd jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 謙和正是對的形容。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not make it look poor.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt meɪk ɪt lʊk pʊr/
dialogue.zh: 別讓她那束看起來寒酸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clean paper never looks poor.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin ˈpeɪpɚ ˈnɛvɚ lʊks pʊr/
dialogue.zh: 乾淨的紙絕不會寒酸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. That was my worry there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðæt wʌz maɪ ˈwɜri ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 好，那正是我擔心的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone worries about that one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriwʌn ˈwʌriz əˈbaʊt ðæt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 每個人都在擔心這一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I carry all three at once?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən aɪ ˈkæri ɔl θri ət wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 我能一次拿三束嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One bunch per arm, then the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bʌntʃ pɚ ɑrm ðɛn ðə bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 一手一束，袋子掛手上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hands, no bag for the bus?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu hændz noʊ bæɡ fɚ ðə bʌs/
dialogue.zh: 兩手滿了，搭公車沒袋子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the paper bag, it is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə ˈpeɪpɚ bæɡ ɪt ɪz fri/
dialogue.zh: 拿這個紙袋，那是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free bag, strong handles, no plastic.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri bæɡ strɔŋ ˈhændəlz noʊ ˈplæstɪk/
dialogue.zh: 免費的紙袋，提繩結實，無塑膠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Handles double stitched, I check each.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhændəlz ˈdʌbl stɪtʃt aɪ tʃɛk itʃ/
dialogue.zh: 提繩雙層縫，我每一個都看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You check the handles? Really?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tʃɛk ðə ˈhændəlz ˈrɪli/
dialogue.zh: 你會檢查提繩？真的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One broken handle ruins a gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈbroʊkən ˈhændəl ˈruɪnz ə ɡɪft/
dialogue.zh: 斷一條繩就毀了禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ruins it in three steps, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈruɪnz ɪt ɪn θri stɛps jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 三步之內就毀了，是喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Down goes the bunch, down goes love.
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊn ɡoʊz ðə bʌntʃ daʊn ɡoʊz lʌv/
dialogue.zh: 花掉下去，心意也掉下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a line for my wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə laɪn fɚ maɪ wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 這句話我想寫在牆上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your wall? I mean my shop wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr wɔl aɪ min maɪ ʃɑp wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 你的牆？我是說我的店牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both walls, then. Where is my card?
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ wɔlz ðɛn wɛr ɪz maɪ kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 兩面牆都貼。我的卡片呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cards wait on the counter, near pins.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrdz weɪt ɑn ðə ˈkaʊntɚ nɪr pɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 卡片在櫃台等，靠近別針。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Near the pins. Is the card paper thick?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɪr ðə pɪnz ɪz ðə kɑrd ˈpeɪpɚ θɪk/
dialogue.zh: 別針旁。卡紙厚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two sheets pressed, so ink will not run.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ʃits prɛst soʊ ɪŋk wɪl nɑt rʌn/
dialogue.zh: 兩層壓的，墨水不會暈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ink running is my handwriting problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪŋk ˈrʌnɪŋ ɪz maɪ ˈhændˌraɪtɪŋ ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 暈開正是我字跡的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then print it, or let me write.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn prɪnt ɪt ɔr lɛt mi raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那就印，或讓我來寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You write? That solves everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju raɪt ðæt sɑlvz ˈɛvriθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 你會寫？那問題全解了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small service, no extra charge.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ˈsɜrvɪs noʊ ˈɛkstrə tʃɑrdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 小服務，不加錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No charge. Now, what should I write?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ tʃɑrdʒ naʊ wʌt ʃʊd aɪ raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 不加錢。那我該寫什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us sit and write the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt əs sɪt ənd raɪt ðə kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 我們坐下慢慢寫這張卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is the pen. What goes first?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ðə pɛn wʌt ɡoʊz fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 筆在這裡，先寫什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her name, then one warm line.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɚ neɪm ðɛn wʌn wɔrm laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 她的名字，然後一句暖話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm line. Give me three choices.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm laɪn ɡɪv mi θri ˈtʃɔɪsɪz/
dialogue.zh: 暖話，給我三個選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, love, and sixty bright years.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks lʌv ənd ˈsɪksti braɪt jɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 謝意、愛，還有六十年亮起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty bright years. That is mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti braɪt jɪrz ðæt ɪz maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 六十年亮起來，就是我要的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It fits a garden lover best.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt fɪts ə ˈɡɑrdən ˈlʌvɚ bɛst/
dialogue.zh: 那句最合愛園藝的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I add her Chinese name?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ æd hɚ ˌtʃaɪˈniz neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我要加上她的中文名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No. She reads English every day.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ʃi ridz ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈɛvri deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不用，她每天都在讀英文。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every day? She loves her old books.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri deɪ ʃi lʌvz hɚ oʊld bʊks/
dialogue.zh: 每天？她愛她那些舊書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then borrow one sentence from a book.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈbɑroʊ wʌn ˈsɛntəns frəm ə bʊk/
dialogue.zh: 那就從書裡借一句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Borrow a line? Whose line, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑroʊ ə laɪn huz laɪn ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 借一句？借誰的句子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours. Real lines beat famous ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔrz riəl laɪnz bit ˈfeɪməs wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 你自己的。真心的句子贏過名家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Real is what I want, no poems.
dialogue.phonetic: /riəl ɪz wʌt aɪ wɑnt noʊ ˈpoʊmɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我要真實，不要詩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then say thank you for the garden.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn seɪ θæŋk ju fɚ ðə ˈɡɑrdən/
