dialogue.zh: 那就為那個園子說謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For the tomatoes and the roses.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ ðə təˈmeɪtoʊz ənd ðə ˈroʊzɪz/
dialogue.zh: 為番茄，也為玫瑰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plant names make her laugh out loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /plænt neɪmz meɪk hɚ læf aʊt laʊd/
dialogue.zh: 寫出植物名會讓她大笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Laugh is good. Sad is not today.
dialogue.phonetic: /læf ɪz ɡʊd sæd ɪz nɑt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 笑是好的，今天不要悲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep Dad out of the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip dæd aʊt əv ðə kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 把爸爸留在卡片外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Out of the card? He is in the flowers.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt əv ðə kɑrd hi ɪz ɪn ðə ˈflaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 留在卡外面？他在花裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, quietly. Five blue stems, remember.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈkwaɪətli faɪv blu stɛmz rɪˈmɛmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 對，安靜地。五枝藍色，記得嗎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Remember. Then the card stays light.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈmɛmbɚ ðɛn ðə kɑrd steɪz laɪt/
dialogue.zh: 記得。那卡片就保持輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Light words carry heavy feeling.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪt wɜrdz ˈkæri ˈhɛvi ˈfilɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 輕的字扛得起重的情。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many lines before it is too much?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni laɪnz bɪˈfɔr ɪt ɪz tu mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 幾行才算太多？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three lines. She will read them twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri laɪnz ʃi wɪl rid ðəm twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 三行。她會讀兩遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twice is a good number for her.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ɪz ə ɡʊd ˈnʌmbɚ fɚ hɚ/
dialogue.zh: 兩遍對她是好數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So keep the paper half empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kip ðə ˈpeɪpɚ hæf ˈɛmpi/
dialogue.zh: 所以紙面留一半空白。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half empty gives room for tears?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ˈɛmpi ɡivz rum fɚ tɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 留一半空白是給眼淚？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or room for one drawn flower by you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr rum fɚ wʌn drɔn ˈflaʊɚ baɪ ju/
dialogue.zh: 或是讓你畫一朵花的空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I cannot draw. My lines shake.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkɑnɑt draʊ maɪ laɪnz ʃeɪk/
dialogue.zh: 我不會畫，我的線會抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shake is honest at sixty years.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪk ɪz ˈɑnɪst ət ˈsɪksti jɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 六十歲了，抖也是真話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At sixty, nothing must be neat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ət ˈsɪksti ˈnʌθɪŋ mʌst bi nit/
dialogue.zh: 六十歲了，什麼都不必整齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost nothing. Your handwriting is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst ˈnʌθɪŋ jɔr ˈhændˌraɪtɪŋ ɪz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 幾乎不必。你的字很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine. Then what do I sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn ðɛn wʌt du aɪ saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好，那我簽什麼名？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both your names, small, at the bottom.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ jɔr neɪmz smɔl ət ðə ˈbɑtəm/
dialogue.zh: 你們兩個名字，小字，寫最下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bottom, not the middle. Agreed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑtəm nɑt ðə ˈmɪdəl əˈɡrid/
dialogue.zh: 最下面，不是中間，說定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Middle is for the wish, not names.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪdəl ɪz fɚ ðə wɪʃ nɑt neɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 中間留給願望，不是名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wish in the middle, names below.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪʃ ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl neɪmz bɪˈloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 願望擺中間，名字在下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly the shape I would use.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðə ʃeɪp aɪ wʊd juz/
dialogue.zh: 那正是我會用的排法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One thing worries me still.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn θɪŋ ˈwʌriz mi stɪl/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事讓我擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spelling? I will write it for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈspɛlɪŋ aɪ wɪl raɪt ɪt fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 拼字嗎？我替你寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you? That removes my fear.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju ðæt rɪˈmuvz maɪ fɪr/
dialogue.zh: 可以嗎？那我的恐懼就沒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say your three lines and I write them.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ jɔr θri laɪnz ənd aɪ raɪt ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 你把三行唸出來，我寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty bright years, thank you, Mother.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti braɪt jɪrz θæŋk ju ˈmʌðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 六十年亮起來，謝謝你，媽媽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three lines, clean, no comma trouble.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri laɪnz klin noʊ ˈkɑmə ˈtrʌbəl/
dialogue.zh: 三行，乾淨，不為逗號煩惱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No commas. Simple is stronger.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈkɑməz ˈsɪmpəl ɪz ˈstrɔŋɚ/
dialogue.zh: 不用逗號，簡單比較有力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strong and soft, the same card.
dialogue.phonetic: /strɔŋ ənd sɔft ðə seɪm kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 又強又柔，同一張卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Black ink or a softer color?
dialogue.phonetic: /blæk ɪŋk ɔr ə ˈsɔftɚ ˈkʌlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 黑墨水，還是柔一點的顏色？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft brown ink on cream paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft braʊn ɪŋk ɑn krim ˈpeɪpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 奶油紙上用棕色墨水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brown, not red. Red feels like a bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /braʊn nɑt rɛd rɛd filz laɪk ə bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 棕色，不要紅，紅像帳單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bills stay outside this counter, friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪlz steɪ ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðɪs ˈkaʊntɚ frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 帳單都留在這個櫃台外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Then a small joke line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðɛn ə smɔl dʒok laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好，那再加一句小笑話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What joke does she always laugh at?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dʒok dʌz ʃi ˈɔlweɪz læf ət/
dialogue.zh: 她每次都笑哪一件事？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She laughs at her own cooking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi læfs ət hɚ on ˈkʊkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 她笑自己煮的菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then write, dinner for someone else.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn raɪt ˈdɪnɚ fɚ ˈsʌmwʌn ɛls/
dialogue.zh: 那就寫，晚餐換人煮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. She will read it aloud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ʃi wɪl rid ɪt əˈlaʊd/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，她會念出聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aloud at the table, with the soup.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlaʊd ət ðə ˈteɪbəl wɪð ðə sup/
dialogue.zh: 在餐桌邊念，湯還在旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The soup is her best dish, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sup ɪz hɚ bɛst dɪʃ ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不過那湯正是她最拿手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then move the joke to the flowers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn muv ðə dʒok tə ðə ˈflaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 那就把笑點轉到花上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Move it? So the joke is flowers?
dialogue.phonetic: /muv ɪt soʊ ðə dʒok ɪz ˈflaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 轉過去？笑點變成花了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes. Say her garden needs more work.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs seɪ hɚ ˈɡɑrdən nidz mɔr wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 對，說她的園子還要多做工。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her garden never needs more work.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɚ ˈɡɑrdən ˈnɛvɚ nidz mɔr wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 她的園子從不需要更多工。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then make it her years, not plants.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn meɪk ɪt hɚ jɪrz nɑt plænts/
dialogue.zh: 那就講她的年歲，不是植物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty bright years, then. Final words.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti braɪt jɪrz ðɛn ˈfaɪnəl wɜrdz/
dialogue.zh: 六十年亮起來，定稿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will write it slow, in brown.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl raɪt ɪt sloʊ ɪn braʊn/
dialogue.zh: 我用棕色慢慢寫上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slow is safer for you and me.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ ɪz ˈseɪfɚ fɚ ju ənd mi/
dialogue.zh: 慢一點對我們都安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. Read it back, check the name.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn rid ɪt bæk tʃɛk ðə neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 寫好了，你念回來核對名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The name is right, no misspelling.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə neɪm ɪz raɪt noʊ ˈmɪsˌpɛlɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 名字對了，沒有拼錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Now the neighbor's card, one line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naʊ ðə ˈneɪbɚz kɑrd wʌn laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好，接著鄰居的卡，一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For Mrs. Chen, what do I say?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ ˈmɪsɪz tʃɛn wʌt du aɪ seɪ/
dialogue.zh: 給陳太太的，我要寫什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching over Mother.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fɚ ˈwɑtʃɪŋ ˈoʊvɚ ˈmʌðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你照顧我媽媽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is short, and very kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ʃɔrt ənd ˈvɛri kaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 那句很短，也很溫柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Short kind words are the strongest ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɔrt kaɪnd wɜrdz ɑr ðə ˈstrɔŋɪst wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 短的暖話是最有力的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No joke on the neighbor's card.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ dʒok ɑn ðə ˈneɪbɚz kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 鄰居那張卡不要笑話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No. She did a serious month.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ʃi dɪd ə ˈsɪriəs mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 對，她撐了嚴肅的一個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Serious, yes. Should I add our names?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪriəs jɛs ʃʊd aɪ æd aʊɚ neɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 很嚴肅。要加我們的名字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only yours. She knows the family.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli jɔrz ʃi noʊz ðə ˈfæməli/
dialogue.zh: 只寫你的，她認得全家人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the hospital card for Cousin Lin?
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd ðə ˈhɑspɪtəl kɑrd fɚ ˈkʌzən lɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那給林表妹的住院卡呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get well, nothing long, no birthday words.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛt wɛl ˈnʌθɪŋ lɔŋ noʊ ˈbɜrθˌdeɪ wɜrdz/
dialogue.zh: 祝康復，不寫長句，不提生日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No birthday words, she is sick.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈbɜrθˌdeɪ wɜrdz ʃi ɪz sɪk/
dialogue.zh: 不提生日，她人在生病。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One wish: a quiet week and spring.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn wɪʃ ə ˈkwaɪət wik ənd sprɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 一個願望：安靜的一週和春天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spring. She loves the sound of that.
dialogue.phonetic: /sprɪŋ ʃi lʌvz ðə saʊnd əv ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 春天，她愛那個音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the daisies say it with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ənd ðə ˈdeɪzɪz seɪ ɪt wɪð ju/
dialogue.zh: 對，雛菊也會跟你一起說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the card change the flower meaning?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə kɑrd tʃeɪndʒ ðə ˈflaʊɚ ˈminɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 卡片會改變花的含意嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The card gives the flowers a voice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑrd ɡivz ðə ˈflaʊɚz ə vɔɪs/
dialogue.zh: 卡片給了花一個聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A voice. Then no blank card, ever.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə vɔɪs ðɛn noʊ blæŋk kɑrd ˈɛvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 有聲音，那就不能留白卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never. A blank bunch feels silent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvɚ ə blæŋk bʌntʃ filz ˈsaɪlənt/
dialogue.zh: 絕不行，空白束像無聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Silent is not what today is for.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsaɪlənt ɪz nɑt wʌt təˈdeɪ ɪz fɔr/
dialogue.zh: 無聲不是今天的目的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then three cards, three small voices.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn θri kɑrdz θri smɔl ˈvɔɪsɪz/
dialogue.zh: 那就三張卡，三個小聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three cards, and no signature is blank.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri kɑrdz ənd noʊ ˈsɪɡnətʃɚ ɪz blæŋk/
dialogue.zh: 三張卡，每張都要簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check mine: written by the shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk maɪn ˈrɪtn baɪ ðə ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 我這張會寫，花店代筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Written by the shop. Is that odd?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪtn baɪ ðə ʃɑp ɪz ðæt ɑd/
dialogue.zh: 花店代筆，會不會奇怪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Odd is fine when it is careful.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑd ɪz faɪn wɛn ɪt ɪz ˈkɛrfɚ/
dialogue.zh: 只要用心，奇怪也沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You would not forget, I trust this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wʊd nɑt fɚˈɡɛt aɪ trʌst ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 你不會漏，我信任這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you. That is the best gift here.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ðæt ɪz ðə bɛst ɡɪft hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，這是店裡最好的禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here? You sell flowers, not trust.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ju sɛl ˈflaʊɚz nɑt trʌst/
dialogue.zh: 這裡？你賣花，不賣信任。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, every morning, for twenty years.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ˈɛvri ˈmɔrnɪŋ fɚ ˈtwɛnti jɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 兩樣都賣，每天早上，二十年了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty years and still writing cards.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti jɪrz ənd stɪl ˈraɪtɪŋ kɑrdz/
dialogue.zh: 二十年還在寫卡片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cards are the slow part of speed.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrdz ɑr ðə sloʊ pɑrt əv spid/
dialogue.zh: 卡片是快速裡的慢部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slow part. Now, how do we send them?
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ pɑrt naʊ haʊ du wi sɛnd ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 慢的部分。那怎麼送出去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow morning, to your home, if you want.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ ˈmɔrnɪŋ tu jɔr hoʊm ɪf ju wɑnt/
dialogue.zh: 明天早上送到你家，如果你願意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six dollars well spent, then. Plan tomorrow's delivery.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈdɑlɚz wɛl spɛnt ðɛn plæn təˈmɑroʊz dɪˈlɪvɚi/
dialogue.zh: 那六元花得值得。安排明天的送貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Morning or evening at your home?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔrnɪŋ ɔr ˈivnɪŋ ət jɔr hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 送到你家，早上還是晚上？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning, before the family wakes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔrnɪŋ bɪˈfɔr ðə ˈfæməli weɪks/
dialogue.zh: 早上，趁家人還沒醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She sleeps late, though. Seven is risky.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi slips leɪt ðoʊ ˈsɛvən ɪz ˈrɪski/
dialogue.zh: 不過她睡得晚，七點太早，危險。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven is too early for a bell.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən ɪz tu ˈɜrli fɚ ə bɛl/
dialogue.zh: 七點按門鈴太早了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then ten, when the water is boiled.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tɛn wɛn ðə ˈwɔtɚ ɪz bɔɪld/
dialogue.zh: 那十點，水燒開的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten is perfect. Between nine and eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ɪz ˈpɜrfɪkt bɪˈtwin naɪn ənd ɪˈlɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 十點正好，九到十一之間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine to eleven is our safe window.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn tə ɪˈlɛvən ɪz aʊɚ seɪf ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 九到十一是我們安全的時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Safe for the driver or for us?
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪf fɚ ðə ˈdraɪvɚ ɔr fɚ əs/
dialogue.zh: 安全是為司機還是為我們？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For the flowers, mostly. Heat is the risk.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ ðə ˈflaʊɚz ˈmostli hit ɪz ðə rɪsk/
dialogue.zh: 主要是為花，熱才是風險。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heat. It is already warm outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /hit ɪt ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi wɔrm ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 熱啊，外面已經很暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our van is cool inside, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊɚ væn ɪz kul ɪnˈsaɪd ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我們的車裡是涼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A cool van. That is a relief.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kul væn ðæt ɪz ə rɪˈlif/
dialogue.zh: 有冷氣的車，我放心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It costs more, but flowers stay firm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kɔsts mɔr bʌt ˈflaʊɚz steɪ fɜrm/
dialogue.zh: 那個比較貴，但枝梗挺得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Firm stems matter more than price.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrm stɛmz ˈmætɚ mɔr ðæn praɪs/
dialogue.zh: 挺的枝比價格重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed. Six dollars is nothing there.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid sɪks ˈdɑlɚz ɪz ˈnʌθɪŋ ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 同意，六元在那裡不算什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six for delivery, so thirty-three?
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks fɚ dɪˈlɪvɚi soʊ ˈθɜrti θri/
dialogue.zh: 送貨六元，所以是三十三？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty-three, with all three bunches.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti θri wɪð ɔl θri ˈbʌntʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 三十三元，含這三束。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty-three. My sister owes me again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti θri maɪ ˈsɪstɚ oʊz mi əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 三十三，我姊姊又欠我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put her share on the small card.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt hɚ ʃɛr ɑn ðə smɔl kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 把她那份寫在小卡上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The address is on the note here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə əˈdrɛs ɪz ɑn ðə noʊt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 地址就在這張單上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it once, slowly, for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ɪt wʌns ˈsloʊli fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 請為我慢慢唸一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Number twelve, third floor, Lane Two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbɚ twɛlv θɜrd flɔr leɪn tu/
dialogue.zh: 十二號，三樓，二路巷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Third floor, no elevator, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /θɜrd flɔr noʊ ˈɛləˌveɪtɚ raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 三樓沒有電梯，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No elevator. Can he carry it up?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈɛləˌveɪtɚ kən hi ˈkæri ɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 沒電梯，他能把它提上樓嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two floors is easy for him.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu flɔrz ɪz ˈizi fɚ hɪm/
dialogue.zh: 兩層樓對他很容易。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Him? One driver for all three bunches?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪm wʌn ˈdraɪvɚ fɚ ɔl θri ˈbʌntʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 他？一個司機送三束？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, then Mrs. Chen, then the hospital.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðɛn ˈmɪsɪz tʃɛn ðɛn ðə ˈhɑspɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 對，接著陳太太，再到醫院。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same morning, same van, three stops.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈmɔrnɪŋ seɪm væn θri stɑps/
dialogue.zh: 同一早、同一車、三個點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three stops, one warm route.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri stɑps wʌn wɔrm rut/
dialogue.zh: 三個點，一條暖的路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the gate be open at nine?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə ɡeɪt bi ˈoʊpən ət naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 九點社區門會開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gates open at seven. No problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡeɪts ˈoʊpən ət ˈsɛvən noʊ ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 門七點就開，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Should I write a code for him?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ʃʊd aɪ raɪt ə koʊd fɚ hɪm/
dialogue.zh: 好，我要給他密碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Codes change. Better to ring the bell.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊdz tʃeɪndʒ ˈbɛtɚ tə rɪŋ ðə bɛl/
dialogue.zh: 密碼會改，按門鈴比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ring the bell? That wakes the house.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪŋ ðə bɛl ðæt weɪks ðə haʊs/
dialogue.zh: 按鈴？那會吵醒一家人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten is late enough, trust that.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ɪz leɪt ɪˈnʌf trʌst ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 十點夠晚了，放心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If she does not answer, then what?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ʃi dʌz nɑt ˈænsɚ ðɛn wʌt/
dialogue.zh: 如果她沒開門，怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He will call you from the door step.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wɪl kɔl ju frəm ðə dɔr stɛp/
dialogue.zh: 他會在門口打給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone must stay on, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn mʌst steɪ ɑn ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那我手機要開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And loud. I will note that here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd laʊd aɪ wɪl noʊt ðæt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 還要大聲，我在這兒記下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Note it twice, I am forgetful today.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊt ɪt twaɪs aɪ æm fɚˈɡɛtfʊl təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 記兩遍，我今天會忘事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice noted. Do not worry about that.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ˈnoʊtɪd du nɑt ˈwɜri əˈbaʊt ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 記兩遍了，那件事別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if nobody is at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ˈnoʊˌbɑdi ɪz ət hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 如果家裡一個人都沒有？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The guard takes them, in cool water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡɑrd teɪks ðɛm ɪn kul ˈwɔtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 警衛會收，放進涼水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The guard? Does he know about flowers?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡɑrd dʌz hi noʊ əˈbaʊt ˈflaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 警衛？他懂花嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He keeps vases here every year.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi kips ˈveɪsɪz hɪr ˈɛvri jɪr/
dialogue.zh: 他每年都在這裡放花瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He does? Then I will leave a note.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi dʌz ðɛn aɪ wɪl liv ə noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 是嗎？那我要留張條子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A note and his name on the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə noʊt ənd hɪz neɪm ɑn ðə bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 一張條子，袋上寫他名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photo proof, is that a thing here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊ pruf ɪz ðæt ə θɪŋ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 拍照存證，這裡有嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes. He snaps the door, then texts you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hi snæps ðə dɔr ðɛn tɛksts ju/
dialogue.zh: 有，他拍了門口就傳訊給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Texts me? From a shop phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛksts mi frəm ə ʃɑp foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 傳訊給我？用店的手機？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our van has one number, saved already.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊɚ væn həz wʌn ˈnʌmbɚ seɪvd ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 我們車上有一個號碼，先存著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saved. Then I know it arrived safely.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪvd ðɛn aɪ noʊ ɪt əˈraɪvd ˈseɪfli/
dialogue.zh: 存了，那我就知道它到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Safely, or a call from me at once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈseɪfli ɔr ə kɔl frəm mi ət wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 平安送到，不然我立刻打給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One call is enough. No extra cost?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kɔl ɪz ɪˈnʌf noʊ ˈɛkstrə kɔst/
dialogue.zh: 一通電話就夠，不加錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No cost on a delivery day.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ kɔst ɑn ə dɪˈlɪvɚi deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 送貨那天不另收費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. What about rain tomorrow?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd wʌt əˈbaʊt reɪn təˈmɑroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好。明天下雨怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain is fine, the paper holds.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪn ɪz faɪn ðə ˈpeɪpɚ hoʊldz/
dialogue.zh: 下雨沒關係，紙撐得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Holds the paper? Or holds the water?
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊldz ðə ˈpeɪpɚ ɔr hoʊldz ðə ˈwɔtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 紙撐住，還是水撐住？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both. Kraft keeps drops off daisies.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ kræft kips drɑps ɔf ˈdeɪzɪz/
dialogue.zh: 兩者，牛皮紙幫雛菊擋水珠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If rain, should I move the time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf reɪn ʃʊd aɪ muv ðə taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 下雨的話要改時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No need. We run rain or shine.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ nid wi rʌn reɪn ɔr ʃaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 不用，我們風雨都送。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rain or shine. I like that phrase.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪn ɔr ʃaɪn aɪ laɪk ðæt freɪz/
dialogue.zh: 風雨都送，這說法我喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old shop phrase, older than me.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld ʃɑp freɪz ˈoʊldɚ ðæn mi/
dialogue.zh: 老店的老話，比我還老。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cut off time, if I change my mind?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌt ɑf taɪm ɪf aɪ tʃeɪndʒ maɪ maɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 如果我改主意，幾點截止？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six tonight. After that, it is booked.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks təˈnaɪt ˈæftɚ ðæt ɪt ɪz bʊkt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚六點，之後就定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six tonight is fine, my mind is set.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks təˈnaɪt ɪz faɪn maɪ maɪnd ɪz sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 六點沒問題，我不改了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set, good. I write tomorrow on the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ɡʊd aɪ raɪt təˈmɑroʊ ɑn ðə kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 好，我在卡上寫明天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On the delivery card? What else is there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə dɪˈlɪvɚi kɑrd wʌt ɛls ɪz ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 送貨單那張卡？還有別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your name, the time, and one line.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr neɪm ðə taɪm ənd wʌn laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 你的名字、時間，加一句。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One line about who it is from.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn laɪn əˈbaʊt hu ɪt ɪz frʌm/
dialogue.zh: 一句寫是誰送的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From you and Sister. That is enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /frəm ju ənd ˈsɪstɚ ðæt ɪz ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 寫你跟姊姊一起送，就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Enough, and no phone number outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈnʌf ənd noʊ foʊn ˈnʌmbɚ ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 夠了，外面不要寫我的電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Numbers on bags leak, sadly.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt ˈnʌmbɚz ɑn bæɡz lik ˈsædli/
dialogue.zh: 聰明，袋子上的號碼會漏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leak. I will trust you on that.
dialogue.phonetic: /lik aɪ wɪl trʌst ju ɑn ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 會漏，那點我相信你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trust, and I will tie it well.
dialogue.phonetic: /trʌst ənd aɪ wɪl taɪ ɪt wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 你信我，我就綁好它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last delivery question, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst dɪˈlɪvɚi ˈkwɛstʃən pliz/
dialogue.zh: 最後一個送貨問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask. I have the schedule in hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk aɪ hæv ðə ˈskɛdʒul ɪn hænd/
dialogue.zh: 你問，排程就在我手上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can she get them earlier, if needed?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən ʃi ɡɛt ðɛm ˈɜrliɚ ɪf ˈnidəd/
dialogue.zh: 需要的話能早一點送嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight is possible, but risky for sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ɪz ˈpɑsəbl bʌt ˈrɪski fɚ slip/
dialogue.zh: 八點可以，但會吵到她睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep wins. Ten is our answer.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip wɪnz tɛn ɪz aʊɚ ˈænsɚ/
dialogue.zh: 睡覺要贏，就答十點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten, written now in blue ink.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈrɪtn naʊ ɪn blu ɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 十點，現在就用藍墨水寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blue ink, like my father's letters.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu ɪŋk laɪk maɪ ˈfɑðɚz ˈlɛtɚz/
dialogue.zh: 藍墨水，像我父親的信。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then ten, blue ink, one cool van.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tɛn blu ɪŋk wʌn kul væn/
dialogue.zh: 那就十點、藍墨、涼的車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One van, and my mother's morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn væn ənd maɪ ˈmʌðɚz ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 一輛車，還有媽媽的早晨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her morning starts with flowers now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɚ ˈmɔrnɪŋ stɑrts wɪð ˈflaʊɚz naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 她的早晨從花開始了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today the plan, tomorrow the flowers.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ ðə plæn təˈmɑroʊ ðə ˈflaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 今天規劃，明天送花。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and a small lesson after that.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ənd ə smɔl ˈlɛsən ˈæftɚ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 對，之後還有一小門功課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A lesson? About the vase at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɛsən əˈbaʊt ðə veɪs ət hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 功課？關於家的花瓶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About water, mostly. You will ask.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt ˈwɔtɚ ˈmostli ju wɪl æsk/
dialogue.zh: 主要關於水，你一定會問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. I killed the last bouquet.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl aɪ kɪld ðə læst boʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我會問，我上束養死了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not this time. I will tell you how.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ðɪs taɪm aɪ wɪl tɛl ju haʊ/
dialogue.zh: 這次不會，我告訴你怎麼做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me before I pay, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi bɪˈfɔr aɪ peɪ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那在我付錢前告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five minutes, while the paper goes on.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈmɪnɪts waɪl ðə ˈpeɪpɚ ɡoʊz ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 五分鐘，趁包紙的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water talk? At the door, or now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtɚ tɔk ət ðə dɔr ɔr naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 澆水的事？在門口講還是現在？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, standing here by the buckets.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ˈstændɪŋ hɪr baɪ ðə ˈbʌkɪts/
dialogue.zh: 現在，站在這水桶邊講。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now is better. I forget so fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪz ˈbɛtɚ aɪ fɚˈɡɛt soʊ fæst/
dialogue.zh: 現在好，我忘得太快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then stand close, and watch one stem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn stænd kloʊs ənd wɑtʃ wʌn stɛm/
dialogue.zh: 那靠近點，看一枝花梗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am standing. Show me the cutting.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈstændɪŋ ʃoʊ mi ðə ˈkʌtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我站好了，示範怎麼剪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First the water, then the knife.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst ðə ˈwɔtɚ ðɛn ðə naɪf/
dialogue.zh: 先講水，再講刀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the part I fear most, watering.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə pɑrt aɪ fɪr moʊst ˈwɔtɚɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 現在換到我最怕的部分，澆水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water is simple. Three steps only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtɚ ɪz ˈsɪmpəl θri stɛps ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 澆水很簡單，只有三步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much water goes in the vase?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ˈwɔtɚ ɡoʊz ɪn ðə veɪs/
dialogue.zh: 花瓶裡要裝多少水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three inches only. Not a full one.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈɪntʃɪz ˈoʊnli nɑt ə fʊl wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 三寸就好，不要裝滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why not a wide, shallow dish?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ nɑt ə waɪd ˈʃæloʊ dɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼不用寬寬的淺盤？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tall glass holds stems straight and clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɔl ɡlæs hoʊldz stɛmz streɪt ənd klin/
dialogue.zh: 高玻璃瓶撐直枝莖，也乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before water, what about the vase?
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr ˈwɔtɚ wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə veɪs/
dialogue.zh: 加水之前，花瓶要怎麼處理？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wash it first. Old dust kills fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑʃ ɪt fɜrst oʊld dʌst kilz fæst/
dialogue.zh: 先洗一遍，舊灰塵壞得最快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soap? Just one drop of it?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊp dʒʌst wʌn drɑp əv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 要用肥皂嗎？只要一滴？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One drop, then rinse twice with clean water.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn drɑp ðɛn rɪns twaɪs wɪð klin ˈwɔtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 一滴就好，再用清水沖兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If some soap stays inside, then what?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf səm soʊp steɪz ɪnˈsaɪd ðɛn wʌt/
dialogue.zh: 如果裡面還有肥皂殘留呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It burns the stem ends. Rinse well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt bɜrnz ðə stɛm ɛndz rɪns wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 會燒到枝莖末端，要衝乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold water from the tap, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld ˈwɔtɚ frəm ðə tæp raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 用自來水的冷水，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool, never icy. Carnations hate cold shock.
dialogue.phonetic: /kuːl ˈnɛvɚ ˈaɪsi kɑrˈneɪʃənz heɪt koʊld ʃɑk/
dialogue.zh: 涼可以，冰不行，康乃馨怕冷激。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I fill it straight away?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən aɪ fɪl ɪt streɪt əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我可以馬上裝水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let tap water stand one hour first.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt tæp ˈwɔtɚ stænd wʌn ˈaʊɚ fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 自來水先擱一個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The small white packet, what is inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɔːl waɪt ˈpækɪt wʌt ɪz ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 那個白色小包，裡面是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flower food. It keeps the water sweet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈflaʊɚ fuːd ɪt kips ðə ˈwɔtɚ swit/
dialogue.zh: 養花的粉，讓水保持清甜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I pour the whole packet?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ pɔr ðə hoʊl ˈpækɪt/
dialogue.zh: 整包都倒進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half is plenty. Too much feeds bacteria.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ɪz ˈplɛnti tu mʌtʃ fiːdz bækˈtɪriə/
dialogue.zh: 半包就夠，太多是在養細菌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How often do I change it?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈɔfən du aɪ tʃeɪndʒ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我多久換一次水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every two days, or each third morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri tu deɪz ɔr itʃ θɜrd ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 每兩天，或每三個早上換一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our room stays warm all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊɚ rum steɪz wɔrm ɔl naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們房間整晚都是暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then change it nightly. Warmth eats oxygen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tʃeɪndʒ ɪt ˈnaɪtli wɔrmθ its ˈɑksɪdʒən/
dialogue.zh: 那就每晚換，熱氣會吃掉氧氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pour the old water down the sink?
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔr ðə oʊld ˈwɔtɚ daʊn ðə sɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 舊水直接倒進水槽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift the stems out, then tip it empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft ðə stɛmz aʊt ðɛn tɪp ɪt ˈɛmpi/
dialogue.zh: 先把枝莖拿出來，再倒空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I cut the ends each time?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ kʌt ði ɛndz itʃ taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 每次換水都要剪末端嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One centimeter, fresh, every second day.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈsɛntəˌmitɚ frɛʃ ˈɛvri ˈsɛkənd deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 每兩天重新剪一公分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kitchen scissors will do, yes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɪtʃən ˈsɪzɚz wɪl du jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 廚房剪刀就可以了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scissors crush stems. Use a sharp knife.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪzɚz krʌʃ stɛmz juz ə ʃɑrp naɪf/
dialogue.zh: 剪刀會壓爛枝莖，要用利刀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cut straight down, or at a slant?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌt streɪt daʊn ɔr ət ə slænt/
dialogue.zh: 垂直往下剪，還是斜著剪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slant it. Less glass touches the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /slænt ɪt lɛs ɡlæs ˈtʌtʃɪz ði ɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 斜著剪，端面就少碰玻璃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I forget a flat cut?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ fɚˈɡɛt ə flæt kʌt/
dialogue.zh: 如果忘記了，剪成平口怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flat ends seal shut. Water cannot climb.
dialogue.phonetic: /flæt ɛndz sil ʃʌt ˈwɔtɚ ˈkɑnɑt klaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 平口會自己封住，水上不去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There are leaves under the water line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɑr livz ˈʌndɚ ðə ˈwɔtɚ laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 水位線下面有葉子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strip those off. Rotten leaves foul water.
dialogue.phonetic: /strɪp ðoz ɔf ˈrɑtn livz faʊl ˈwɔtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那些要摘掉，腐葉會弄臭水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The top leaves, do I touch them?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tɑp livz du aɪ tʌtʃ ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 上面那些葉子，我要動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave them. They feed the open blooms.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ðɛm ðeɪ fiːd ði ˈoʊpən blumz/
dialogue.zh: 留著，它們會餵開著的花。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do they stay pretty?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ du ðeɪ steɪ ˈprɪti/
dialogue.zh: 它們能好看多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven to ten days. Ten, if lucky.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən tə tɛn deɪz tɛn ɪf ˈlʌki/
dialogue.zh: 七到十天，運氣好就十天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ice cubes help in hot weather?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪs kjuːbz hɛlp ɪn hɑt ˈwɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 天熱時加冰塊有幫助嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No ice. It bruises petals. Trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ aɪs ɪt ˈbruzɪz ˈpɛtəlz trʌst mi/
dialogue.zh: 別加冰，會磕傷花瓣，相信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My drawer has old flower food pills.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ drɔr hæz oʊld ˈflaʊɚ fuːd pɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 我抽屜裡有舊的養花錠劑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the packet date. Old ones do nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə ˈpækɪt deɪt oʊld wʌnz du ˈnʌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 看一下包裝日期，舊的沒有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No sugar? My aunt always adds sugar.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈʃʊɡɚ maɪ ænt ˈɔlweɪz ædz ˈʃʊɡɚ/
dialogue.zh: 不加糖嗎？我阿姨一定加糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sugar feeds bacteria. It clouds the water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɡɚ fiːdz bækˈtɪriə ɪt klaʊdz ðə ˈwɔtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 糖是養細菌，會讓水變濁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When is water too cloudy to keep?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn ɪz ˈwɔtɚ tu ˈklaʊdi tə kip/
dialogue.zh: 水濁到什麼程度就不能留？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Today. Cloudy means bacteria already started.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ ˈklaʊdi minz bækˈtɪriə ɔlˈrɛdi ˈstɑɚtɪd/
dialogue.zh: 當天就換，濁代表細菌已經起了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The window table gets sun by noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ˈteɪbəl ɡɛts sʌn baɪ nuːn/
dialogue.zh: 靠窗那張桌子中午就有太陽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sun on leaves, never on the petals.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌn ɑn livz ˈnɛvɚ ɑn ðə ˈpɛtəlz/
dialogue.zh: 太陽只照葉子，不要照花瓣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Move them away from the fruit bowl?
dialogue.phonetic: /muːv ðɛm əˈweɪ frəm ðə fruːt boʊl/
dialogue.zh: 要把它們移離果盤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes. Ripening bananas murder tulips fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs rɪˈpaɪnɪŋ bəˈnænəz ˈmɜrdɚ ˈtulɪps fæst/
dialogue.zh: 要，香蕉一熟，鬱金香很快就謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kitchen stove is also warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɪtʃən stoʊv ɪz ˈɔlsoʊ wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 廚房爐子旁邊也暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep flowers away from heat and smoke.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ˈflaʊɚz əˈweɪ frəm hit ənd smoʊk/
dialogue.zh: 花要遠離熱氣和油煙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the television set also a problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈtɛləˌvɪʒən sɛt ˈɔlsoʊ ə ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 電視機也是問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm air dries petals. Give them space.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ɛr draɪz ˈpɛtəlz ɡɪv ðɛm speɪs/
dialogue.zh: 暖風會吹乾花瓣，留點空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should the bunch face the light evenly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd ðə bʌntʃ feɪs ðə laɪt ˈivənli/
dialogue.zh: 花束要均勻對著光嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn the vase each quiet evening.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðə veɪs itʃ ˈkwaɪət ˈivnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 每個安靜的傍晚轉一下花瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One side leans toward the window glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn saɪd linz təˈwɔrd ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ɡlæs/
dialogue.zh: 已經有一邊歪向窗玻璃了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the plant reaching. Turn it twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə plænt riˈtʃɪŋ tɜrn ɪt twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 那是花在伸手，轉兩圈就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I mist the leaves with spray?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən aɪ mɪst ðə livz wɪð spreɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我能用噴霧噴葉子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mist leaves only. Wet petals spot brown.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪst livz ˈoʊnli wɛt ˈpɛtəlz spɑt braʊn/
dialogue.zh: 只噴葉子，濕花瓣會生褐斑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did that spray bottle come with mine?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðæt spreɪ ˈbɑtəl kʌm wɪð maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那個噴瓶是跟著我的花束給的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, free. Take the spare on the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs fri teɪk ðə spɛr ɑn ðə ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 對，免費，把架子上的備用瓶拿走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Extra food packets too, or just one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛkstrə fuːd ˈpækɪts tu ɔr dʒʌst wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 養花包也多給，還是隻有一包？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three are in the bag. Keep two.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ɑr ɪn ðə bæɡ kip tu/
dialogue.zh: 袋子裡有三包，留兩包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mother will want to check them daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌðɚ wɪl wɑnt tə tʃɛk ðɛm ˈdeɪli/
dialogue.zh: 媽媽會想每天檢查一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That suits her. Mornings are hers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt suːts hɜr ˈmɔrnɪŋz ɑr hɜrz/
dialogue.zh: 那很適合她，早上是她的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We travel next month for six days.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈtrævəl nɛkst mʌnθ fɚ sɪks deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我們下個月要出門六天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask a neighbor, or set an alarm.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ə ˈneɪbɚ ɔr sɛt ən əˈlɑrm/
dialogue.zh: 請鄰居幫忙，或設個鬧鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An alarm on my phone at nine?
dialogue.phonetic: /ən əˈlɑrm ɑn maɪ foʊn ət naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 手機鬧鐘設在九點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Name it flowers. Then you cannot ignore it.
dialogue.phonetic: /neɪm ɪt ˈflaʊɚz ðɛn ju ˈkɑnɑt ɪɡˈnɔr ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 把它命名為花，你就不能忽略。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if they droop on day three?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ðeɪ drup ɑn deɪ θri/
dialogue.zh: 如果第三天就垂下來呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deep water, thirty minutes, firm stems again.
dialogue.phonetic: /diːp ˈwɔtɚ ˈθɜrti ˈmɪnɪts fɜrm stɛmz əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 深水泡三十分鐘，枝莖會又硬挺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whole bunch under the water surface?
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊl bʌntʃ ˈʌndɚ ðə ˈwɔtɚ ˈsɜrfəs/
dialogue.zh: 整束都浸到水面下面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once, for rescue. Then no wet petals.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌns fɚ rɪˈskjus ðɛn noʊ wɛt ˈpɛtəlz/
dialogue.zh: 泡一次急救，之後花瓣不再沾濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One carnation already bows its head.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kɑrˈneɪʃən ɔlˈrɛdi baʊz ɪts hɛd/
dialogue.zh: 有一朵康乃馨已經低頭了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cut that stem short. It lifts again.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌt ðæt stɛm ʃɔrt ɪt lɪfts əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那枝剪短，它會再抬起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Petals on the floor mean dying, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɛtəlz ɑn ðə flɔr min ˈdaɪɪŋ raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 地板上有花瓣就是快死了，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Normal loss, not failure. Pick them up gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɔrməl lɔs nɑt ˈfeɪljɚ pɪk ðɛm ʌp ˈdʒɛntli/
dialogue.zh: 是正常掉，不是養壞，輕輕清掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I pull the loose petals off?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ pʊl ðə luːs ˈpɛtəlz ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 我要把鬆動的花瓣扯下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only fallen ones. Pulling bruises the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ˈfɔlən wʌnz ˈpʊlɪŋ ˈbruzɪz ðə rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 只清已經落的，亂扯會傷其他的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mrs. Chen's small bunch: same rules?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪsɪz tʃɛnz smɔːl bʌntʃ seɪm rulz/
dialogue.zh: 陳太太那小束，規矩也一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same water, shorter stems, cooler shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈwɔtɚ ˈʃɔrtɚ stɛmz ˈkulɚ ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 水一樣，莖剪短，放涼一點的架子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cousin Lin shares one small room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌzən lɪn ʃɛrz wʌn smɔl rum/
dialogue.zh: 林表妹跟別人共用一間小病房。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No strong smells in a sick room.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ strɔŋ smɛlz ɪn ə sɪk rum/
dialogue.zh: 養病的房間不要放濃香。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that why we picked a faint lily?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt waɪ wi pɪkt ə feɪnt ˈlɪli/
dialogue.zh: 這就是我們挑淡香百合的原因嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes. One lily fills a whole hallway.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn ˈlɪli fɪlz ə hoʊl ˈhɔˌleɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對，一支百合就香滿整條走廊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dried petals stay flat inside my book?
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪd ˈpɛtəlz steɪ flæt ɪnˈsaɪd maɪ bʊk/
dialogue.zh: 壓乾的花瓣就平放在我書裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press them for two weeks, then keep.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ðɛm fɚ tu wiːks ðɛn kip/
dialogue.zh: 壓兩週，之後就能留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tulips grew taller after one night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtulɪps ɡru ˈtɔlɚ ˈæftɚ wʌn naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 鬱金香過一夜就長高了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They keep growing in the vase. Expect bend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ kip ˈɡroʊɪŋ ɪn ðə veɪs ɪkˈspɛkt bɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 它們在花瓶裡會繼續長，也會歪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eucalyptus needs the same careful water?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌjukəˈlɪptəs nidz ðə seɪm ˈkɛrfəl ˈwɔtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 尤加利也要這樣仔細換水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Barely. It dries beautifully without any water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛrli ɪt draɪz ˈbjʊtəfəli wɪˈðaʊt ˈɛni ˈwɔtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 不太用，它無水也能漂亮地乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hang the lavender upside down, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæŋ ðə ˈlævəndɚ ˌʌpˈsaɪd daʊn ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那薰衣草就倒掛起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loose tie, dark room, two slow weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /lus taɪ dɑrk rum tu sloʊ wiːks/
dialogue.zh: 鬆鬆綁，暗房，慢慢晾兩週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next week, which flower should I try?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst wik wɪtʃ ˈflaʊɚ ʃʊd aɪ traɪ/
dialogue.zh: 下週我該試哪一種花？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask me in late spring for peonies.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk mi ɪn leɪt sprɪŋ fɚ ˈpiəniz/
dialogue.zh: 牡丹要等春末，到時再問我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today I came for flowers, not lessons.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ aɪ keɪm fɚ ˈflaʊɚz nɑt ˈlɛsənz/
dialogue.zh: 今天是來買花，不是來上課的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every bunch teaches something. Sleep well tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri bʌntʃ ˈtitʃɪz ˈsʌmθɪŋ slip wɛl təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 每一束都會教一件事，今晚好眠。
